name: Barack Obama
subject: There are reasons for hope
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
People who believe in equality and democracy have faced powerful opposition before. But they’ve also risen to the challenge, and defended the fundamental rights that make us who we are as Americans.
|
---

Friend --

**By striking down _Roe v. Wade_ , the conservatives on the U.S. Supreme Court signaled their intent to give extreme Republican state legislatures significantly more power over fundamental rights to privacy.** And in an upcoming case -- _Caster v. Merrill_ \-- the Court’s conservatives could allow state legislatures to adopt maps that dilute the voting power of voters of color.

That means Republican state legislators could roll back even more fundamental rights -- and their own constituents might not be able to stop them.

_Caster v. Merrill_ is part of a decades-long campaign by conservatives to roll back the landmark Voting Rights Act (VRA). During my presidency, the Court’s conservatives chipped away at the VRA’s requirements for states with a history of discriminatory voting practices. In this latest case, they could do something similar nationwide.

[**The through-line here is clear: Conservatives on the Supreme Court are looking to roll back hard-won rights by declaring that those rights can be subject to the whims of gerrymandered state legislatures. They did it by overturning _Roe_ , and they may do it again by further undermining the Voting Rights Act. name: Team Catherine
subject: Still thinking about Roe…
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Approved by Catherine For Congress
body:
Still thinking about Roe...
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/79102/images/parker%20PP%20rally.JPG]
The signals were there, so I was not surprised when Roe v. Wade was overturned and it looks like we are headed for some pretty dark times. As Justice Clarence Thomas made clear in his opinion, we may be looking at bans on contraception, and we know there will be those gunning for a federal ban on abortion.
We would all love to see Roe v. Wade codified. We would all love to see Justice Clarence Thomas and Justice Amy Coney Barrett impeached and removed from the Supreme Court. We would even like to see the court expanded so that we don’t have to continue watching our basic human rights eroded by the court that was appointed during the Trump administration.
But we have to be realistic, and look at what we can actually do. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherineforcongress?refcode=activis]
Why do I think these ideas are unicorns? We saw that 10 days after Roe v. Wade was overturned, New Yorkers were not concerned enough to come to the polls and vote in the gubernatorial primary. We know that Republicans are using the war in Ukraine and supply chain issues that have led to inflation as a criticism of the Biden administration. And we’re facing the midterms which traditionally always goes against the party that holds the White House. Talk of actions such as impeaching Supreme Court Justices or packing the courts are great ideas if we had an overwhelmingly democratic Senate and House of Representatives.
But we don’t. And it is highly unlikely that we will in the new term. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherineforcongress?refcode=activis]
We have to look at protecting women’s rights to reproductive freedom on a more granular level and what we can realistically get done. Because right now, it’s the incremental change that will be the most damning to our opponents.
Take cybersecurity and privacy laws - a bipartisan issue in Washington. Can we take the opportunity to ensure that apps and technology that help women track their menstrual cycles are protected from turning over that information to states that are putting a bounty on women who may be seeking abortions? The same could be asked of rideshare apps and protecting information if a woman is going out of state to get the necessary reproductive care she needs.
These are the kinds of ideas I bring to the table. These are the kinds of ideas I know I can deliver on. And these are the kinds of ideas that men won’t have because they will never understand what it means to be a woman in this country.
Catherine

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Now is the time
body:
The Pennsylvania Governor's race is entering the homestretch. Will you split a donation between Josh Shapiro and CommonGood, so Josh can stop extreme Republican Doug Mastriano? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220801_CGVA_JS]
Derek -
Yesterday marked 100 days out from November 8th. The 100 days before that weren't easy.
Roe vs. Wade was overturned by SCOTUS and rising costs have made it harder to afford everyday expenses. But from that pain, we have managed to grow this campaign into one that will meet this moment and deliver real results – if we come together and work for a victory in November.
We’ve worked hard to put this campaign in the best position it can be for these last 100 days. And with new polling confirming that this race will be won or lost by a razor-thin margin, we can’t afford to take a single vote for granted.
These last 100 days will make or break this campaign — and have a huge impact on the future of Pennsylvania. To reach our fundraising goal, can you rush any amount now to my campaign and CommonGood? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220801_CGVA_JS]
Over the past 100 days, we’ve seen a clear picture of what kind of politician my opponent Doug Mastriano is and how he might govern. He’s been open about his desire to overturn election results, ban abortion without a single exception, and spread conspiracy theories.
We all know that this is the time to get everyone off the sidelines and in the game. We need rural voters, urban voters, Democratic and Republican voters, and everyone else to get involved and make their voices heard.
Why? Because it's our very freedom on the line this time. The freedom to choose, the freedom to love, the freedom to unionize. The list goes on and on.
So Derek, as we head into these last 100 days, the stakes are higher than ever and this will be a tough race to win — but we must win to safeguard our freedoms and deliver for Pennsylvanians. Can I count on you to contribute to my campaign to make headway in this race and to CommonGood? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220801_CGVA_JS]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220801_CGVA_JS&amount=25]

Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220801_CGVA_JS]
I know I can count on you when we have to take on these big fights and I’m thankful to have you on my team.
Thanks again,
Josh Shapiro
Democratic Nominee for Pennsylvania Governor

Team Dunn

body:
You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, “Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,” on DVD.

Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6aeqb48m9aeudvoavbm3gp17n4as7qukfem9dqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjm0or0sdh2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztjb6koq1c5488bnbdos4ti9674lf1amn2477gdg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjm0or0sdh2bs) Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs7k14ontm0e2buqstl4v0j26c7966kumhin6ttg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjm0or0sdh2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8ueqtrdijgmuot0rchvrkus9ngu4ob2175cel50_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjmcoj6c3h2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhb5g7qibioqgbte6odrr9ptcbnmg0r0rc4ueoc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjmcoj6c3h2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development

body:

Fellow American, It's no secret ... **_Being a cop is dangerous. _** Law enforcement officers have one of the most dangerous jobs in the world right now, as violent crime rates continue to skyrocket in cities everywhere. What many average citizens don't realize is that officers are at high risk of severe physical injury on the job every day, and often do not receive adequate medical care ... It can all change in an instant - without warning. That's why I'm writing to you today... **_Our team at Code3 has drafted a petition to provide adequate care and support for Police Officers injured or disabled in the line of duty._** [**CLICK HERE: SIGN THE NATIONAL PETITION TO CARE FOR INJURED OFFICERS**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
[**Sign The National Petition**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
When you hear horrible news of an injured police officer, most people assume the medical treatment and ongoing care are covered ... But far too often, that is not the case. **Most permanently injured and disabled officers never receive the necessary medical care and financial assistance they deserve and need.** **_... That's where Code3 comes in. _** We support these injured officers and help to equip them with the resources they need to recover and regain their life. _By signing our petition today, you will be helping change the system for injured and disabled police officers across the country. _ [**_Please sign our national petition demanding the government to provide adequate care and support for Police Officers who have been injured or disabled in the line of duty._**](http://trk.readactnews._SRGM-vXAw)
---
[**Sign The National Petition**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
Nearly every month in this country, 30 officers are shot in the line of duty. Even more are attacked with knives, vehicles, and other weapons ... and don't forget about hand-to-hand combat, foot pursuits and other dangerous encounters. But sadly, many injured officers and their families do not have the benefits to take care of medical expenses and basic essentials. There is very little support for officers who survive a deadly encounter and are disabled - _That's why we have created this national petition._**_ _** [**_By signing this petition, you will help bring awareness to our injured and disabled officers in need of care, so please sign now. _**](http://trk.readactnews.-A)
---
[**Sign The National Petition**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
Too often, the very system that promised to look after them, refuses to cover their basic medical and financial needs. **This petition is a crucial first step in changing the way our brave officers are treated in this country. But we desperately need your signature to make that happen.** **[Please sign the petition now. ](http://trk.readactnews.)** We need good people like you who'll step up to the plate and support our injured officers by signing today. **God Bless, **
---
**Dale Sutherland** **President & Founder** **Code 3**
---
[**Sign the National Petition**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---

subject: Did you catch the debate?
body:
Cynthia was unbought and unbossed in her first debate! | | | Friend, Last Friday, Cynthia Mendes had her first Lieutenant Governor debate against Sabina Matos, Deb Ruggiero, and WOW did she do an amazing job! Cynthia brought energy, passion, and answered every question clearly and directly. We need a Lieutenant Governor who will stand up to the corruption in our State House and work with integrity and compassion. Cynthia demonstrated today that that’s exactly what she will do when she’s elected. [Watch the full debate here](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDOJPR4Z5lDybbWIPhQSOR8HePOM_0u9Clm1QgeOEsBs3tWZjf2tmLnKHIE-KCpZfiujTWw3lkEsFqKCzYNOzZc0tXziSv3gJFipf3N48d0Ayt-FA7Mb3wfiHzOx_B5QzuWX-axGupyDo07BKF-CnXQkluldy0YYJ1ihW7n8xJTaZcmHPCTdLfrc_FkbEr4fbjF5HtdoPfCsomyqc-OsyDLcoEPKmJfuyG5iHosV5lXeLW-7w3mbyH_DIcFHs8gaxOpVnVsuu581MEKLZTicJfEc/3o8/Zfbv2oZ2Sr69SSvVIl7jXw/h0/uqbUqzHq19dSRt4TNEBuSq8tPNU0j2l_G7n4bfKxlSc)

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/CMxF4nARlf6wAFa1PSfv0t6Ke6oybIu7rip7-lZ0cixx2KGdCSaAIKqIN6aEo-HnPMgDesx-C5FWnB8YsvclB1XoRh-S7I4ds5OiMw8d4g6lmLKsBJvfuKAbW3mO8Kv7fntmME5TGKlZuQY6lp1zy6OSBgxUF4L6nh-GLGl6hIAFThyg9yXdFUl7I-fR7u9biOaUq9zuvTYtyDpOI4JuI6NCkEUvFb5W29dP0kQs2LgzRR-BKbZhO94PGHLUyufhalqI5pa9XUQHswD8pcSOjbqXwyMDHmtSOxtUQ-AFo5O7Spy5RNs5R4VaKk3y350rFbpUzyvEsYsuKhxyAsvhR8ykBEkPKG8BggpL3Sh_gz8/3o8/Zfbv2oZ2Sr69SSvVIl7jXw/h2/IMGNJFGqK9Wd3m3Rny0eCQPgs92lS5FAEEqZpEPgOHQ)**On the Equality in Abortion Coverage act:**

Cynthia closed strong saying, "I have a simple question for the people watching: do you believe that the politicians running our state are working for you, or are working for someone else?... We deserve a Lieutenant Governor that is unbought and unbossed. The corporate lawyers and career politicians have had their turn. It’s time we trust community leaders and working-class people instead." **You can watch her closing statement here:** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/CMxF4nARlf6wAFa1PSfv0t6Ke6oybIu7rip7-lZ0cizCyPhN1eyJB-hmRyvngbZdVO6mDdUqH0mrwhntUc320kjf23xk4D5AgRWZ2Rw6JXet1mNW5RFn4VfUv5jTcs8kgvahIaw48bcSxpiFEFwc7ghsbCYFvHNy7hDJ-F9JDFEXFLLAsKxEIAmqibmO0U0X5CsKLtwkBT1lT8ez-xeJJVYDg3qHQq0DVKrXoKWnqEB3EVDz1ZZzDlQ7gS2MlzhAFiRR5nwGDzr-8THLMN1YFXkT6tF7FL6h_EHc1iQQOgik4uqqq2jLplnmiYSBcyAkiP1wuUjPdG-nWJue0syPzQF0xRcmjGP3WFLPqEp18XM/3o8/Zfbv2oZ2Sr69SSvVIl7jXw/h5/JY9gXLlcBBl5Ge_PYlc27HxDqREs_Iv-eb-_3jfj6-Q) During the debate, Cynthia pointed out that our campaign is not taking any corporate PAC or corporate lobbyist money. We rely on grassroots donations in order to compete with our well-funded opponents. Debates like these help get our message out but we also need resources to get our message out to voters on the doors and with ads. **[Can we count on you to donate $5, $10, $50, or whatever you can today to keep up our momentum after this HUGE debate win?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqq1ShOM1Z9sA3tehBXlHcZj9RK-7XRKdXi3A8iRElOn0kF_MM9eCLaEStWe-OsA7k7x0mI0Xy0JV7cqMnH2TxjepdDqZ3_XcOA1GLGJJ5HgRpU658BMwrRMouxp1Y6cqNL1xa8hA-8IMDGoc6GLzilCN6nUntQ067wnQI1-MvHi_yBsEJt4pd2jV5bYC8Wj1IQUcSFzVCNohCqbh5a8m1xZSRWCCC3m4Fs1m0WEoJ91919YwuSpCmf9w7RxvbrzYvPvVOdDwPWJYuBjugdSdiEdYLOXdmwHD-VNUhZIPgmBzOhnX0bLzY7SMei6ju7bY/3o8/Zfbv2oZ2Sr69SSvVIl7jXw/h6/7BrAc-YsBCuDD4ElksQHS6-Y_QKz-8GkEE9xDnHakUg)**
We have just over 6 weeks left until the primary – so let's get it done! \-- Team Matt and Cynthia

body:

| | | Patriot, it's Tim Scott. I only have a minute so I'm going to get straight to the point.

I grew up in a single-parent household and almost failed out of high school. If it weren't for my supportive mother and mentors, who knows where I would be today.

The American Dream - the possibility of going from cotton to Congress - was never guaranteed to me. Now, I'm committed to making sure that every child has the same opportunities regardless of which side of the tracks they grew up on.

But listen, Patriot, winning this fight is impossible without your support.

Patriot, it would be an honor if you continued to support me - can you spare $10 to help me continue my fight in the Senate?

---
| | | [I'LL CHIP IN $10](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60919228:Jvzs1kVwN:m:1:3299561967:D6C709573FDA7964694A6619F9462EE3:r "I'LL CHIP IN $10")
---

I'm in the Senate to fight for the American dream for all Americans. That means fighting for kids who grow up in circumstances like mine, protecting our God given rights, and expanding opportunities for all Americans regardless of race, gender, age, and political identity.

I'm a humble person and hate asking for favors. But I'm nothing without you - I can't do this on my own. **Our extended mid-month deadline is TODAY and we can 't waste any more time. We haven't raised enough to hit our goal, but it's not too late.**

Dream.")**

Thank you,

Tim Scott

body:

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zrceifd04ggoa4q2esg74e85786fsgbh6npottpo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjmao34chh2bs)

subject: From my heart to yours...
body:
| |
---
| | | Friend,

Let me first start by saying thank you for all the help you've given me to get to this point. It seems like it was years ago when I announced my candidacy for Congress on _February 17th_. It's been quite the ride since then.

I've traveled to every county in our district attending festivals, picnics, meetings, church services, meet and greets, you name it. I went wherever there was a crowd of people that I could talk to and tell them why I wanted to represent them in Washington, D.C.

My message was simple... I'm not happy with the direction our country is going. Inflation is through the roof, gas prices hit an all time high and the Biden Administration is imposing crazy mandates on us that cost people their jobs. Crime is rampant, and of course to the Left, defunding the police is the supposed answer.

Schools are trying to indoctrinate our kids with CRT and pushing the LGTBQ agenda down our throats with gender dysphoria. President Biden, Nancy Pelosi, and The Squad are trying to radically transform our country and they are claiming that anyone who doesn't go along with it is either homophobic, xenophobic, or racist. Well, I reject that. They can't silence my voice by calling me a racist.

I am a common sense Pastor who plans to go to Washington to speak up for our conservative Christian values. They will not silence MY voice. They will not silence OUR voices.

We've done all we can to get our message out to the fine people of Southwest Missouri. The political establishment said it couldn't be done. We've knocked on doors, raised money, made phone calls, hung countless door hangers, met thousands of people, preached in churches, and we fasted and prayed.

On Tuesday, we will lay it all in the hands of the Lord. But today, we have one more opportunity to encourage people to vote for Alex Bryant for Congress.

I am asking you to personally text and call all of your friends, coworkers, and neighbors and remind them to go to the polls tomorrow and VOTE their ABC's - Alex Bryant for Congress.

>From my heart to yours, I am...

Your Fresh Voice for Our Values,
---
|
---
|
#### Alex Bryant
Candidate for Congress
Missouri’s 7th District

| Breitbart News By Nick Gilbertson Former President Donald J. Trump slammed Missouri Attorney General Eric Schmitt's U.S. Senate campaign Sunday night over a poll that Republican strategists told Breitbart News undercounts Trump's support in the Show Me State to boost Schmitt's numbers.
"Wow, great dishonesty in politics. Too bad!" Trump [wrote](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010SbCVbrLPVhE6m0KTBUzK56QIxVUO8aIHRmp8XNGkrxHb3Rgw0-TGmU7d74R6VUd7MTOB0gOaBnXdSBmxdGBmROlF7BcCurjw4JfGq_EIdIuXcpn3JwBi1t331DAFX62De0vuBq_A63Ivy9PGnPrvoSaGsrdfbnVXDLBNWzYvkFL3SCQvMx2Z64Zw0C8PKj9ZgDHaPS92NVuQSWIhWhE8w==&c=anRXZuD-RmIrPTXWLnJkpnMi1FQQCIRAvTNduHGWB9TBZ7xEjepFSA==&ch=ISNu9hoQU82Pnuq1w9OVeBaxwjhJtTxFKfEg0jToOKrbLtDekqbWsg==) of the Remington Research Group poll -- commissioned by operatives associated with the Schmitt campaign -- in a Truth Social post. Remington was [launched](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010SbCVbrLPVhE6m0KTBUzK56QIxVUO8aIHRmp8XNGkrxHb3Rgw0-TGkf1L_lu0W7piwXhP2k7-OmCIEB196q_dV6-A16QSduJVKxxmHiIV4wqbrnh0Ur6Cf4SqKMzYW2CoXnE3jh2xmsDjm7XmFS6UTD4kMJV9ETE4hiEKP0pig3bvTbQOKmGY5UkyogTrZ2fHV4C0Srs5pdACWVgVEQQEb3v4_bBSRdDIqp4_CLAsTqMEDdqL5IcrA==&c=anRXZuD-RmIrPTXWLnJkpnMi1FQQCIRAvTNduHGWB9TBZ7xEjepFSA==&ch=ISNu9hoQU82Pnuq1w9OVeBaxwjhJtTxFKfEg0jToOKrbLtDekqbWsg==) by the political consulting firm Axiom Strategies, which was founded by Jeff Roe -- Schmitt's top consultant.
With voters hitting the ballots in less than 36 hours, Trump's Truth Social post indicates it is highly unlikely he will endorse the attorney general in the race. Having already previously [announced](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010SbCVbrLPVhE6m0KTBUzK56QIxVUO8aIHRmp8XNGkrxHb3Rgw0-TGgd--5hNlAA1iOqLbxDYXT8WtHLkkkm_bH-lZCakKoLgXLm3KtfMTHOV6pJanC_7H0asr2UTPqrIBihk3d9MvtDyIsKnL2VfTq216fyzIIF-l3Iv7Fb4wsAjjPQlg8HwZpwcPqbplms9v0nYq7UN7SCOg1YmkqOn6wLf6L3C_VWhvyiQuwJN80VdsmLkLjFFuSVU-uFlQlH7yIiN_8XQOq4=&c=anRXZuD-RmIrPTXWLnJkpnMi1FQQCIRAvTNduHGWB9TBZ7xEjepFSA==&ch=ISNu9hoQU82Pnuq1w9OVeBaxwjhJtTxFKfEg0jToOKrbLtDekqbWsg==) that he would not support Rep. Vicky Hartzler (R-MO) and telling voters they "can forget about" her, only one candidate seems to be in contention for his backing: former Gov. Eric Greitens (R-MO).
...
"This is a completely fake poll commissioned by the RINO establishment who are looking to move on from President Trump," a national Republican operative who advises candidates in both Missouri and Florida among other places, [told](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010SbCVbrLPVhE6m0KTBUzK56QIxVUO8aIHRmp8XNGkrxHb3Rgw0-TGmU7d74R6VUdyKiW2zwTXKkItTsHra8ViS5QVP14B9KiXP0gn7752gG9rEcJzMwoArVj_GojfbmIp07hRHmBtdXzhdT28BiqK669oaOhD1pQkE4_fkmn2PAApOjOyGmrr6tzHYaVfMaAozz77YaduMMhrn6LssATi3d9wlNlR29NbHo2UfzeorkFNgOlzLcR3MSeou3taYbMk8g8I2XZPFs5MhgYUiOBQkn0T47QDxtH&c=anRXZuD-RmIrPTXWLnJkpnMi1FQQCIRAvTNduHGWB9TBZ7xEjepFSA==&ch=ISNu9hoQU82Pnuq1w9OVeBaxwjhJtTxFKfEg0jToOKrbLtDekqbWsg==)Breitbart News. "There is no way Missouri, a deep Trump state, would ever vote for someone like Ron DeSantis. President Trump is dominating the state and every other state in the country."
"President Trump is way higher in Missouri than this poll states, and everyone knows it," a second GOP strategist told Breitbart News. "Clearly, something funky is going on in Missouri with people trying to undermine Trump's return to the White House. Take this with a very big grain of salt."
"Something is off about these numbers, and you have to wonder why," a third strategist told Breitbart News.
"Perhaps it is because the only way Schmitt's team can alter a poll to make it look like they are in the lead in Missouri's Senate primary days from the election is by kneecapping Trump and boosting perceived potential rivals in a looming 2024 bid," the strategist added.
An Excalibur Strategies survey [obtained](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010SbCVbrLPVhE6m0KTBUzK56QIxVUO8aIHRmp8XNGkrxHb3Rgw0-TGkf1L_lu0W7pQZBBHoA-7lwnkYkeKgrLfxWd9RURwRCuoHBRRJuGfJ3NvEdColrp9fCPOptMJfG2ieZpIDHI7S_6v33mqgtvQeA0GZISw1lOitfBREwwZeI_EGFhzSXOUZWkvSi4k-GQd6KpoYT-F9368u9Aj133uTIN9M_0Dr-CU4MvR2fmTt-pCIyOUSq0kTZ8XFTrC1qN1HDRIC7yIwhc7HRP5vNdWQ9VKxEQPuiHNogehyKoloA=&c=anRXZuD-RmIrPTXWLnJkpnMi1FQQCIRAvTNduHGWB9TBZ7xEjepFSA==&ch=ISNu9hoQU82Pnuq1w9OVeBaxwjhJtTxFKfEg0jToOKrbLtDekqbWsg==) exclusively by Breitbart News showed Greitens at 34 percent, Schmitt at 30 percent, and Hartzler at 21 percent as of Friday night.
Read the full story [here.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010SbCVbrLPVhE6m0KTBUzK56QIxVUO8aIHRmp8XNGkrxHb3Rgw0-TGmU7d74R6VUdSh8QkZblWo_F19JKiAJgLkntjSOsKUf7HAnSxFEFrYow-eARRmja1cqE3gP4MwsiDQp9vPLfH9ASWzebTus8aZvU-P_YD_X0smf2Gfs4qTmVpDNk78ZB0pFRFaqI1Rf67fEF-JOIvU0NcWMWABRhW3mkWjYrznIxSEWGiN5QE0V0KGuTVNHO1qSxr-E76bWkjPP58dDkoWO36HL4Fqrp7g==&c=anRXZuD-RmIrPTXWLnJkpnMi1FQQCIRAvTNduHGWB9TBZ7xEjepFSA==&ch=ISNu9hoQU82Pnuq1w9OVeBaxwjhJtTxFKfEg0jToOKrbLtDekqbWsg==)

subject: Thank you.

body:
You are making an incredible impact.
#

Friends —
I know that we sent a lot of emails ahead of last night’s fundraising deadline. So, I just wanted to send a quick thank you before the primary tomorrow.
In difficult moments, Gabby has always reminded me to summon hope. To keep going, even when it seems darkest. And with a team like this behind me, I know we’ll defend this seat and hold the Senate.
We received tens of thousands of donations ahead of yesterday’s deadline, which speaks volumes about the depth of support for this people-powered campaign. It all adds up to help us reach voters ahead of tomorrow’s primary.
It’s no secret this is going to be an expensive campaign, and my decision to not accept corporate PAC money makes fundraising a little more challenging. But it was the right decision and all of you have made an incredible impact.
I am very proud of that fact, and you should be too. Let’s head into tomorrow’s primary on the strongest foot possible and get ready to defend this seat.
Thanks again,
Mark

name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: All the way to the finish line
body:
So between now and then, what we do matters – and I couldn't be more grateful that you are with me as we move full speed ahead.
| | |
---
Good news, Derek. We reached our July fundraising goal – all thanks to you, our grassroots supporters who power this campaign.
**In less than 100 days – 99 to be exact – it’ll be Election Day. So between now and then, what we do matters – and I couldn't be more grateful that you are with me as we move full speed ahead.**
But let me be clear: My Republican opponent and his allies are working hard to flip PA-06 red, with House Majority Leader Kevin McCarthy himself saying our district is a TOP target for the GOP. But with your support, I know we can stop them.
In my time in Congress, I've never stopped fighting for working families, because I know everyone deserves the chance to thrive. I intend to continue to champion and serve the people of Chester and Berks counties – to protect reproductive freedom, help small business owners, drive down costs, and ensure that our kids receive a world-class education.
The difference between me and my opponent could not be more stark or urgent. From protecting our very democracy to protecting reproductive care, there's a lot at stake right now. **But together, we can keep the momentum going all the way to the finish line and keep PA-06 blue.**
Thank you for your unwavering support, Derek. There is work to be done**.**

Chrissy

| VA Delegate John McGuire
I'm running for State Senate in 2023 so we can "Un-California" Virginia.
Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner)
---
| Dear Friend,
Please vote! We know that Democrats created a 45-day election season here in Virginia. The first day of in-person voting begins September 23, and of course the final day to vote in the General Election is November 8, just 100 days away.
Inflation, open Boarders, fentanyl, life, our 2nd amendment, and more are on the ballot this November. Much more important than me, at this point in time, is getting Bob Good, Yesli Vega, Rob Wittman, and the rest of our congressional delegation elected this November. Yes, I am running for State Senate, but we can worry about that more after November. Please pray, vote, volunteer, and help spread the word so that we can win back Congress and stop the Biden White House.
I'm working on legislation for 2023. Please email your ideas to: [john@mcguireforvirginia.com](mailto:john@mcguireforvirginia.com)
Here are some of the things on my mind, and what I've been up to around the district:

| I attended the Celebration of Life, and the funeral of former Delegate Jack Reid. He was a man of faith, and he and his wife, Judy, were very active in their church. You would have enjoyed the wonderful stories of respect, which I heard from members of my Republican caucus, who were talking about Jack. He was a highly respected member of the Virginia House of Delegates, and he had a huge impact on Virginia. He served as chairman of the Republican party in the third Congressional district, and was a regular and reliable volunteer and surrogate for Virginia's state wide Republican candidates for years, before seeking office himself. He traveled across Virginia, advocating for conservative ideas and candidates, from then California governor, Ronald Reagan. to local nominees for County Sheriff.
"During his time in office, Jack deliberately chose not to fill the docket with excessive legislation saying as a conservative it was just as important to stop bad ideas and bad bills as it was to introduce new legislation." This is something we have in common, as I often say sometimes the best bill is no bill at all. Jack would have turned 80 years old today.
His son and our friend, John Reid, does a wonderful job advancing our conservative message on the radio show, Richmond's Morning News, 6-10am, with John Reid. RIP Jack.

Ms. Anderson, of the Religious Studies Department of the University of Virginia,demands that we censor and silence Thomas Jefferson and James Madison because they owned slaves. We all agree slavery is beyond evil, but there is so much more to Jefferson and Madison. Our Founding Fathers pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor. Had we lost the war, they would have all been hung and we, including Ms. Anderson, myself, and everyone else in America, would not enjoy the God given freedom we enjoy today. Read this article [(Click here)](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vyrQDDo1YtsyBOp0ZktpzuN_mVD3uiyHey2vO99WbgLQ46xF-Ayr-Arov5hdP1OGsb_qs0_X6RvNBBGeHA4L8o-o0MjrTxTH76XEzjATf0hMV560iJGju6iigACpWEN3iD5Hn5CVPNi8kBOctt0Vvv0vfJx1SwjnzUjLu7my-JT4jBypmW5X3-iK6fRgDcJwcSCWYaLWmXvX_kIj43SHxNEp0GI_BC1WseqTN5p27OAx0ceQcwOe_YGwtNI4B_mGDaj_9THmfmW_C2wxGgc-9BIZu04QsVuN&c=NNTiNCdlvRt_Dsx_N1uVxg2vi6MJ2l1JdpqIVWUZBntUVCsmXU9zKw==&ch=o8XCXPb1s7XoKYGAId4c3SlyaqQotT8MTqNTw6eILwnClCnnIL2dmA==) from 2019 where Democrats are not too happy with my voting record. I did put my initials on a piece of paper supporting the bill in 2018 when I was first elected (5 years ago), at the request of a Republican, but then I withdrew my support once I better understood the bill. What I learned back then was the facts on the negative history of the ERA, and I learned that broadly written legislation can be dangerous, because it can be interpreted any way the Democrats want. The good news is Virginia's Republican Attorney General Jason Miyares withdrew Virginia from the legal push to recognize the Equal Rights Amendment ratification.
Here is a list of my votes against ERA:
ERA 2018
HJ 129- Roxann Robinson (Republican) referred to P&E never heard and left in committee meaning no-one voted.

#1 HJ 577- Sam Rasoul Referred to P&E Sucom #1 1/22/19 PBI (4-2) McGuire voted to Pass By Indefinitely (PBI or kill the bill)

#6 House voted adoption 1/15/20 59y-41n- 1/17/20 McGuire voted no

"Thank you for being in the fight, thank you for being part of the solution". | The Virginia National Guard Military Ball | | | Tracy and I enjoyed the Virginia National Guard Military Ball. Thank you for your service! | Door Knocking with Yesli Vega | | | | Yesli Vega has a lot of momentum going into the final 100 days of her campaign to unseat radical democrat Abigail Spanberger. Please contact her Campaign Manager Eric Paige 518-796-9702 to volunteer, contribute, knock doors, and more! | 2000 Mules Powhatan County | | We will show the movie, "2000 Mules", in Powhatan County on Thursday, August 18, at 7pm, at Powhatan High School, 1800 Judes Ferry Rd, Powhatan, VA 23139. Put the word, "Powhatan", in the email subject line. Please bring family and friends. RSVP to john@mcguireforvirginia.com | Correct Link on 2nd Amendment | == | A well regulated Militia, being necessary to the security of a free State, the right of the people to keep and bear Arms, shall not be infringed. I recommend you watch this video of Representative Clay Higgins speaking against Red Flag Laws. "That's a yes or no question; I got 5 minutes to make an hour and a half statement". == | RIP Delegate Jack Reid | | I attended the Celebration of Life, and the funeral of former Delegate Jack Reid. He was a man of faith, and he and his wife, Judy, were very active in their church. You would have enjoyed the wonderful stories of respect, which I heard from members of my Republican caucus, who were talking about Jack. He was a highly respected member of the Virginia House of Delegates, and he had a huge impact on Virginia. He served as chairman of the Republican party in the third Congressional district, and was a regular and reliable volunteer and surrogate for Virginia's state wide Republican candidates for years, before seeking office himself. He traveled across Virginia, advocating for conservative ideas and candidates, from then California governor, Ronald Reagan. to local nominees for County Sheriff. "During his time in office, Jack deliberately chose not to fill the docket with excessive legislation saying as a conservative it was just as important to stop bad ideas and bad bills as it was to introduce new legislation." This is something we have in common, as I often say sometimes the best bill is no bill at all. Jack would have turned 80 years old today. His son and our friend, John Reid, does a wonderful job advancing our conservative message on the radio show, Richmond's Morning News, 6-10am, with John Reid. RIP Jack. | Anti-Awoke Song "Progress" | == | Country Music Star, John Rich, anti-woke song, "Progress", is number one on iTunes. Click this link to listen: == | Jefferson Madison Library Name Change | | | | | As the only elected official to show up and speak against the name change of the Jefferson Madison Library, I'm glad to see the majority of people who showed up prefer to keep the name, "Jefferson Madison Library". Ms. Anderson, of the Religious Studies Department of the University of Virginia,demands that we censor and silence Thomas Jefferson and James Madison because they owned slaves. We all agree slavery is beyond evil, but there is so much more to Jefferson and Madison. Our Founding Fathers pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor. Had we lost the war, they would have all been hung and we, including Ms. Anderson, myself, and everyone else in America, would not enjoy the God given freedom we enjoy today. Should we defund institutions that promote anti-American ideas, such as canceling our Founding Fathers? Here is my speech: == | Motivation | | | Veteran Support | | | | | | | | I joined Governor Youngkin, Delegate Vanvalkenburg, fellow veterans, and many Walmart Employees at Walmart in Short Pump, for the announcement that Walmart joined the Virginia Values Veterans (V3) Program. Through Democratic and Republican Admins, V3 has enlisted over 2,000 businesses who have hired over 96,000 veterans. | ERA Clarification | == | Life is a miracle and it begins at conception, full stop. I've never voted for ERA, but I have voted against the ERA many times. Read this article == from 2019 where Democrats are not too happy with my voting record. I did put my initials on a piece of paper supporting the bill in 2018 when I was first elected (5 years ago), at the request of a Republican, but then I withdrew my support once I better understood the bill. What I learned back then was the facts on the negative history of the ERA, and I learned that broadly written legislation can be dangerous, because it can be interpreted any way the Democrats want. The good news is Virginia's Republican Attorney General Jason Miyares withdrew Virginia from the legal push to recognize the Equal Rights Amendment ratification. Here is a list of my votes against ERA: ERA 2018 HJ 129- Roxann Robinson (Republican) referred to P&E never heard and left in committee meaning no-one voted. 2019 #1 HJ 577- Sam Rasoul Referred to P&E Sucom #1 1/22/19 PBI (4-2) McGuire voted to Pass By Indefinitely (PBI or kill the bill) #2 HJ 579- Jennifer Carroll-Foy Referred to P&E Subcom #1 1/22/19 PBI (4-2) McGuire voted to PBI #3 HJ583- Jeion Ward Referred to P&E Subcom #1 1/22/19 PBI (4-2) McGuire voted to PBI #4 SJ 284- Glen Sturtevant Referred to P&E Subcom #1 1/22/19 PBI(4-2) McGuire voted to PBI 2020 #5 HJ1- Jennifer Carrol Foy passed P&E 1/14/20 13y-9n- McGuire voted no #6 House voted adoption 1/15/20 59y-41n- 1/17/20 McGuire voted no | Fluvanna Conservatives | | | | Tracy and I met some wonderful people at the Fluvanna Conservatives meeting. Excitement for our Senate campaign continues to grow. Thank you! | Buckingham GOP Committee | | | | | "President Trump joined us in Buckingham County for "2000 Mules"!" Thank you, GOP Chair Ramona Christian, and others for making this a successful event. Congratulations to those who joined their committee Thursday night! Bill Hawkins, Director for Virginians for America First, gave us an update on election integrity in Virginia. Thank you, all! Please consider joining the Buckingham GOP Committee and get involved so we can win back Congress in November. Call Ramona Christian at 434-391-4546 or Jacob Eubanks at 434-547-3356. | Goochland GOP Committee | | | Good to see our friend Republican Party of Virginia (RPV) Chairman, former Member of the Virginia House of Delegates, and fellow veteran Rich Anderson at the Goochland GOP monthly meeting. Thank you for your continued service and leadership in Virginia. "It's time to lead and fight again". | Louisa County | | Tracy and I ran into former Louisa Sheriff Fortune's daughter, Kim. You should hear her preach on Sunday. She is amazing! Senate District 10 is home to some amazing people. If you see me on the side of the road, give a beep or stop by and say hello and get a yard sign. I look forward to seeing you soon! | Lake Anna Civic Association | | | | | | Delegate Buddy Fowler of Hanover and I attended a Lake Anna Civic Association Fundraiser in Louisa County. We have been working hard to help Lake Anna get a solution to the Harmful Algae Bloom issue for three years. This year there is $3.5 million in the budget to help solve the issue. | Anti Woke | == | How crazy can you get? People are getting sick and tired of these "woke" liberal Democrats. Florida Governor DeSantis called out transgender, Admiral Rachel L. Levine, MD, Assistant Secretary for Health (ASH), who speaks out about the importance of "gender-affirming care" for children and young adults. These ridiculous ideas are harming children, and this is one of many reasons why we are going to win in November. Florida Governor DeSantis also said, "If you look at California, they never lost population from the founding of the state until this current governor has been in office. Now they're hemorrhaging people. Illinois is hemorrhaging people. New York and their tax bases are getting narrower and people are bringing wealth to Florida and opportunities to Florida," == | Governor Youngkin | | Governor Glenn Youngkin just donated his second quarter salary to the Jones & Cabacoy Veterans Care Center. Thank you for loving our veterans and thank you for loving our Commonwealth! | Virginia's 3-Day Sales Tax Holiday August 5 - 7, 2022 | == | When is it? August 5-7, 2022. The 3-day sales tax holiday starts the first Friday in August at 12:01 am and ends the following Sunday at 11:59 pm. What is it? During the sales tax holiday, you can buy qualifying school supplies, clothing, footwear, hurricane and emergency preparedness items, and Energy StarTM and WaterSenseTM products without paying sales tax. # **Friend — Election Day in Kansas is TOMORROW!**

---
This is a pivotal election, not just for our state but for the entire nation. With the Value Them Both amendment on the ballot, Kansas has the opportunity to lead the way in protecting life following the Supreme Court’s Dobbs ruling. In 2019, the Kansas Supreme Court threw out our pro-life laws and paved the way for unlimited abortions. We have an opportunity to fix that. This is deeply personal for me, because pro-life isn’t just a slogan for me. It’s been my life’s work. [**If you live in Kansas, I hope you’ll join me in committing to support Value Them Both. And if you don’t, I hope you’ll commit to stand with me in defense of life throughout our entire country.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/80611874979feca4041ad8cde91a9694/37973/9eeaefcc3f5f4068/ae9f19f95f73918ac3d6b838967d376c/37973)

subject: What’s the difference between America and Venezuela? [Spoiler, less than you think.]
body:
Until I was expelled for political reasons, I was a medical student in Venezuela.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm3tuja9qqh2cq13t6dac0b8sqs33nberkq00pa8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjm1or2clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfad30mao67chi6dh65dr4sdjjed5kelqr2sj2m5ibddtks9or8p5kscoe8sjic1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9d9m61p70pjh62pm8dtgmlin49fg)

Friend,

Until I was expelled for political reasons, I was a medical student in Venezuela.

You see, I traveled to several states of Venezuela, presenting two speeches, _" Let's Talk about Ayn Rand"_ and _" Defending Capitalism." _**Then in 2019, I gave a speech at the Organization of American States _denouncing_ Venezuela's rampant human rights violations.**

Because I defended human rights and condemned the dangerous practices that my home country adopted, I was expelled.

I came to America (legally) soon after. But since I've been here, I've noticed socialism gaining popularity among high school students, and it worries me.

Friend, this new generation doesn't understand the true horror of socialism.

_That 's why I want to tell my story to students across America_.

[_**Can you help me tell students the truth about socialism? Click here to send your donation of $3, $17.76, $35, or any amount today >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2p5u2l1uak9f234e7sq3e8vrcfi5chgp32ued9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjm1or2clh2bs)

Let me introduce myself. I am Franklin Camargo, a Venezuelan immigrant and a **Dissident Project** speaker.

**The Dissident Project** provides high schools with access to informed, intelligent perspectives on how authoritarianism takes hold, what happens when it does, and what America can learn from current and former socialist states worldwide.

**Let me share how the Dissident Project works:**

Dissident Project speakers come from countries across the globe, including Venezuela (like myself), China, Cuba, and North Korea.

First, we undergo a rigorous audition process. Then we go through a training program to prepare us to communicate our experiences in a powerful but compassionate way.

_We are specially trained to address students and have mastered the art of covering difficult and complex topics for young audiences_.

The Dissident Project is a not-for-profit endeavor. We provide speakers to schools across the United States at no cost to make their testimonies more accessible to all.

**But to keep our services completely free, we rely on the generosity of our donors. Will you chip in today and support the Dissident Project?**

[_**Click Here to Donate NOW >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvakpfpfob11s75cendkpr5rpirrd5f2ha31tk60_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spjm1or2clh2bs)

I am starting to see more similarities to Venezuela here in America every day.

Venezuela didn't fall to socialism because of a revolution. It was through our elections and the nationalization of industry. It was because anyone who offered a different perspective was banned from campuses and attacked with hatred.

_**I was shunned in my country for talking about ideas that didn 't fit the government narrative.**_

And if America isn't careful, issues like these will lead to our downfall.

I survived socialism in Venezuela and started a new life in America, but not everyone is so lucky.

**I would rather tell my story about the horrors of socialism to every high school in America than have students live through it themselves.**

It costs roughly $1,000 to host a speaking event on a high school campus.

Your donation goes directly towards the cost of providing speakers for schools. **Click any button to show your support.**

body:

| | | | | Peter, **Imagine winning the presidency. But losing. ** That wasn't a misprint. It's 2024, we turn out, vote Democratic to reject the GOP coup, fored birth, rapist rights, AR-15s for 15 yr olds and tax increases on 98% of us for a new personal-jet-tax loophole. We WIN a huge electoral majority**. **State legislatures around the country, however, disagree.** ** **GOP state legislators overrule OUR overwhelming vote for Democrats and send electoral slates to Washington, supporting Donald Trump or Ron DeSantis or, hell, Kid Rock for that matter. ** **[_Can you please join me, Stacey Abrams, Michelle Obama and other concerned Democrats in doing all we can to "keep it," by supporting Andy’s Fight right now with a donation of $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford?_](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc6552e88-18a3-479f-a54c-2bd95231d6e0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **_This is not fiction. I wish it were._** **The same Supreme Court that forced a traumatized 10-year old girl to travel so she wouldn't have to carry a rapist's child will hear a case, ****Moore v Harper ****in only two months. It will likely end with their declaring state legislative supremacy.** **_Authoritarian to its core, this would mean the will of gerrymandered Republican state legislatures can decide which electoral votes count and which don't, no matter for whom we voted._** It is pure insanity. And it absolutely could happen. This is why even though it's not as sexy nor as covered on cable news, WE MUST win control of as many state legislatures as possible. And** it's why I'm so thoroughly supporting Andy's Fight, a new SuperPAC launched by Andy Parker, which will target key Republican seats---including state legislative ones--to ensure we win majorities in as many state legislatures as humanly possible in November**

We can do this with Andy's Fight. Andy's Fight won't talk about it--THEY WILL DO IT!!** As Benjamin Franklin walked out of Philadelphia's Constitution Hall in 1787, an onlooker asked him whether we'd be "a republic or a monarchy." Franklin's rejoinder has echoed across time: "A republic. If you can keep it." **[_Can you please join me, Stacey Abrams, Michelle Obama and other concerned Democrats in doing all we can to "keep it," by supporting Andy’s Fight right now with a donation of $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford?_](https://default.salsalabs.org/T371f217a-a505-4e33-a6b9-fe7e74d572b6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Thank you for your tireless devotion to democracy. Make sure you cast a ballot tomorrow! | | Peter, I just wanted to remind you to vote in tomorrow's state legislature primaries! Polls will be open from 6:30 AM to 7:30 PM. You can still vote as long as you're in line before the polls close at 7:30 PM. We did already have primary elections for other offices, but this time we'll be voting on primaries for Ohio House and Senate seats. These primaries were pushed back to August due to disagreements over new district maps. Your polling place may have changed since the last election. You can find your voting location for tomorrow using the buttons below. To request an absentee ballot or to cast your vote in person, Ohio law requires some form of identification, including: An current Ohio driver’s license or state ID card with present or former address, as long as your present residential address is in the official list of registered voters for that precinct A military ID A photo ID issued by the United States government or the state of Ohio, that contains your name and current address, and that is not expired A utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other document with your name and present address from the last year. For more information on how to vote, No matter who you vote for, it's important to our state and our country that you get out and make your voice heard! body:
This could be it. We're hanging on by a thread.

_**ONE. DAY.**_

That's all we have left until election day, and frankly, Peter, this could be it. We're hanging on by a _thread_.

Senate Democrats just have too much power, Patty Murray has too many connections, and Washington state has too much Democrat money flooding in.

If her opponent Patty Murray destroys her in the polls, there is no hope that Senate will be able to put the brakes on the Biden Agenda next year.

[**So, we 're going to be blunt. We need ALL CONSERVATIVES to chip in $25 RIGHT NOW, so Team Smiley can reach and exceed our goals to blow Patty out of the water!**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60919033:6nZQykVBN:m:1:3317145305:0CE1ACB8E21375B2A9911EDFFC1890D8:r)[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60919033:6nZQykVBN:m:1:3317145305:0CE1ACB8E21375B2A9911EDFFC1890D8:r)

We need you right now. We have too much to lose.

- Team Smiley

Hello,
When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ **I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.**
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.
**And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other.**
Now, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things are going to get even nastier. I am sure of it, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue.
**In order to be ready to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before our next critical fundraising deadline, but right now, we’re still falling pretty short. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so if we’re going to have the resources we need to win, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give right now:**

Leon Benjamin ****

body:
Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0561%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=Fgg6oHeRjk4VZzPA0U%2fQYw&sysid=1)
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39275%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nzlKtuaVrHwuJxZ80VRlog&sysid=1)
---
Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39276%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jLzrOOoSyg%2bHev86NWqFeA&sysid=1) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think--and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39277%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jz2dU1RMMqKx8O9Qi9BTFw&sysid=1)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development

### **New Ad on Gun Safety**
---
Dear Friend,Today, I released a [new ad on gun safety](https://mgcp03.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62e7f6e73c2ac13e5ecc5d26&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tededwardsforcongress.com%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D62e7b961f44e6f19d1c0b0fd%26ss_email_id%3D62e7f6e73c2ac13e5ecc5d26%26ss_campaign_name%3DWatch%2Bmy%2Bnew%2BTV%2Bad%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-08-01T15%253A53%253A38Z&w=62a23ccb05070a1330f6e585&l=en-US&s=gSP28P_dXxK1ODCExMklpoZNxqQ%3D). name: Tim Ryan
subject: grateful to have you on my team
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tim Ryan for Ohio
body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/18421?t=1008&amount=25&akid=4861%2E3611125%2EJYzypI ]Tim smiling

I want to thank you personally, team. We needed to raise
$350,000 from online grassroots supporters before our End-of-Month
deadline on Sunday, and my staff just told me that we knocked it out of
the park!

This was our most ambitious goal to date, and without grassroots donors
like you stepping up to the plate, we wouldn’t have been able to get it
done. So from the bottom of my heart: Thank you, friend.

But listen, this game ain’t over yet. With less than 100 days until the
election, we’re basically tied coming out of the seventh inning
stretch—and we can’t drop a single ball if we want to win this thing.

It took everything we had to hit our July fundraising goal, and our August
goal is even bigger. That means we can’t waste any time celebrating—we’ve
gotta get right back out on the field. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/18421?t=1009&amount=25&akid=4861%2E3611125%2EJYzypI ]I’m personally asking if you’ll
rush in $5, $25, or whatever you can to help us start this month off
strong.

I’ve lived in Ohio my entire life and I’ve seen firsthand how workers and
families have been cut out of the deal. I’m running for Senate to change
that.

There’s no doubt about it: If we’re going to win and give working families
a fair shake, we need to build a grassroots movement that’s got the stuff
to take on Republican billionaires and dark money groups. And it starts
with you, folks.

I’m so grateful to have you on this team. Together, I know we’ve got what
it takes to flip this Senate seat blue and expand our Democratic
majority.

—Tim

name: President Jessica Post
subject: I wanted to share this podcast with you
body:
“The best time to get involved in state legislative races was in 2010. The next best time is now.” | | |
---
| | Do you find yourself constantly saying the same thing over and over at work? For example, I often see lots of jokes playfully poking at the overuse of “let’s circle back” or “per my last email.” Well, for me, my personal tagline at work is **“The best time to get involved in state legislative races was in 2010. The next best time is now.”** My colleagues hear me say it repeatedly, but **_it’s true_**. In the 2010 midterms, the GOP deployed an unprecedented mobilization effort around state legislative races. Republican’s spent $30 million on the cycle alone and as a result, flipped over _680 seats_ and _22 chambers_ from blue to red. The good news is that we’ve taken the lessons learned from 2010 and applied them to our winning strategy. The DLCC has been leading a generational shift in focus and resources on state legislatures. But even in 2022, we’re still feeling the effects of the 2010 midterms. Don’t just take my word for it: I recently came across this episode of _The New York Times’_ The Daily, titled “On Abortion Laws, it All Goes Back to 2010.” It does a great job of explaining how we got here, and how much of the solution lies in the work we’re doing at the DLCC. **[I wanted to share it with you today and hope you’ll give it a listen or bookmark it for later.](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDGlyFEPfIQqTPhAJ7ICxnKFFjHO2er6td-iQfsnPrY_PSgk51GNijmxnljK1OlcbMWXmI1vUufWX9_w5pBLfQhuvLKi1CAwX_TVQhFQG4jNGoLArXCjhGrKiRm2kBltDtGqjJW_Gd1UeXmd5Tkq0nM6-WKe9BldGpnQKkWWgSjs0vd2o3OeFiDk4j6x5Qm4i0B8DMBaYngIzwb8T2C6wgnqRmfdQdvpU6gDxHrfa9wl23Gwct8HHTe0zsuDxtGXDu1dyQvGKUDRU_1Pq-dd70h7wlv0tYS3o59UNlNkDehUKy9BQPZswu82JPcqZQ9mz4SwLvNWOF06ojc1sl2Y70k-BcCUqR87oSZCLHA8huAPpmHjqGk5SERs1YTbvxtsL_VBuVDhDBOnzpe0lkDyVZAHVIVReHNdlTcUxLraycaWSUAw-fQV0VBItVGxO9aX-ixPXh4BIFQNjkr7WQ8oHdq53nuigYE1wkbPvqWuYlYI9ADHOFcnnsTGRiQD9nTezxKUuf38CO0pPMQe7ICzj6LI/3o8/SDI7dF_SRi6RbLVIotFxYQ/h0/AStXfVm-Z03sC61HsnEaxWKLi0rG-PvlcxjhgvQzEXM)** You can understand why I say “the best time to get involved in state legislative races was in 2010” so much, and join me in making sure we can continue to take our power back, defend our reproductive rights, and safeguard our elections at the state level – in 2022 and beyond. Thank you for being on this team. Your support does not go unnoticed. Jessica Post

name: Hillsdale College via CIntel
subject: The might and drama
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWXQ7L2hNd

Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its
sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our
fascination ....
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWXQ7L2hNd

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

We
generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and
powerful emperors.

But
overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of
imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through
a far different form of government.

Did you
know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his
Empire from the Roman Republic?

The story
of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes
in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the
Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating
narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the
perils of success.

To help
tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently
released our free online course, "The Rise and Fall of the Roman
Republic."

You can
now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the
Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or
more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty.

And, for
a limited time, we'll also send you a free color map of the Roman
world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper.
This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will
illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures.

Simply
use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of "The Rise and
Fall of the Roman Republic," along with the companion map today:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd

Learning
the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary
to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way.
That's why we produced "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"
and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Before I
go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future
generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale
College!

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeB35cNhzcLd8pK344znm_hqWNYX3WZQRTcsMp6GJBdazak9tc-cGurYPGSpVpDHIrxbKzUh6slsz5oLR7awRyrn8P_V05wcFRybCGATSBUuBfdfFLHqbc_hn1FOOkDrE_vgt2tsP5fhQlEN5LyTG8B6Yb6FBTcp2woOKCY8Zj56uLrvkVsdjmP7vyComahYPEXi1fhgWW9YqPHm1A7O4mL4%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeEcZpPKV9QJM6HKZLnWRc2dmd0IDlEoqI5io9n1k0hT2qqmbFIgaUjZu50KwxC49jEKpImtXLmxl2hp95DakZ_XluqnDpVH_8XE252ZbeqnYpAFB1oJadOULFuvDcnT9zzq_BypzyXk77fiT3D-UhZE4Kjkfwx8cpYQzq-miOId9hhSMHgNZ_u9jvpSp1pMbESFQKkrcmuNcRS8JgdXdRCk%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeJc_Dm8hDFZF5lAmoL_Ixo-EN5SLchC46e9FqogEG84ORxPdqCGLgfslTXOFU26pwHgYGVzz5u_AoErSWUNlvcPCnRh-1xJATR5jyem4WrypNLsN4ogSKy53DHKAIUfAUIaQb-x1HnzhlX1Zd25spGQt7D0YGYoEVcllr-6yxn1PoDVVPIOWlaBEbwxfRMJtMtKw98Ec1iTXFVRKvTiECB4%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeKYRQRpNVCBLGxC4mPJRm9qyYgAkr2-tgTI25uXS9sZ1TZqZlZb11Sn5Re3VGW3V4QJ9ASzGAWIZ405CAFIuuzlz9BlCX04afa9a44gcH-VLNcadOoJZUXPCrvc6MtUizUCHEq5-YyHc2iCOlDBXxlCiIM3jl8a2VmxiU6N6twixWNbzpPdzykn888PuEVUof6yNFdkfb_VuZO_IBdrLm34%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeCjLWWbszRdfCWIoG2L2QUCP0xGbCbbfvkhz0ld_Ete7Vhx1GswdBnI4bOPVlMr99usp3mX20fQU-_U9h5sQSXgyEXYzLOjrxwUufC89EMrQDMmP4NzhqXvqMyTLLR4MdVuthlsid1xX6QwRqSDqRzoyM0-H2p0GEIOzfv0MZBlqF01kXxUF8EDb8ITZWjrHidvbyOyyP56t1X6QYk_P_Lg%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeO9W40T9JH78c3U7AM4qf0GmbbOf3KhDVsDQQtnLyafiw5RhJj4uzQIkTNLebymjbW8SA317_BPZXu70Vep_QqU4rpPmmrhPUyWng-2qLMIWWu2zL-0ifjyIF_uVxklM3dphedxVJ1GMmdCH-ZZY237IesI0m_hSEPS9Wjdl1jr1MuDLxtCbNFtnIUoxXnCLgJEHiCjLjwUjttMic3I-3K8%3D)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeAxBQiEU0ZZvRbTptvU3_IgYncJzg-pArrqaRig0sFzDZnUCM8cwTBXFSmP2NJKuV935evik9y3fG0y-KlLC59J6A1c1Xm-WC8Bk6CUaQFLE6yhntunZv8vNJBFnbz0Dd4eDuIq9r5BtKh819WLfc8syQBk4MgHBZBn2wZLIAHBMYZ_S1AtY1B15jG6xyjahTFsfVBhwQh2RC-6YlPyu85U%3D)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT’s events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tev7FG7s21JZX2Ni_o4EMeTeMu-TT43roOc2Baw8qvi8DRrfrLFdmsn1Yi53xuh5niG4XCT6TYSs53q-oBKG2Pfp-LD8FTM8VEc39lGq5V9F98j4l18Y0G_QpcDBqSURT2V23UJXdLcRhDjX7wk_8Koe1aFxzlDSKmru-m4clNZnXZeK7x703gA-RmyNnyFQ223eXXeRPlVqB1GPKNjZoMLYtvHyB-8gTrgUtHBcbuYafM%3D)

What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b065336f957641018f56b87bd5679340&_e=qW1zibdzDsozfwb68novhDjkUNwIgBL_mlg7WBdQFLTmfWZN3XUnwD4IAsLZFaT_BNlHD-_Ykd5jkLO6ELQFTnPPWHjLHuRBTx5AXnGWUg0e9X7zYROqta7NB0sc8tevJqKEGgP1Opgv7eLg5uC6plbdB7CZfTKR8Yceo6aWbVb6HvL1-BBKVZiR_c6_BGU3O-bU_d1MDSG5dmyL0VSrhcOM98M67qiEEJ_rH57oOoqpwNh2gdEW_txvI_-eM9ya3Nx9ILyc4RrhvmGhn0tWMvWKH3U3qK7mTNefi1RI8cQzVneZ2aNgJJWdDl_QHd4Dp2XxTCjI_Ws55mfI_jjIujaMqcmGwG4O1Ilog2tsKp8%3D)
