clean_body: Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I’ll share my story ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I’ve dealt with racism... I’ve even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I’m not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation Sent to Defend the Constitution subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

| | Dear Derek,

When John launched his independent campaign for the United States Senate in Missouri, our first critical goal was to collect the 10,000 signatures required to place his name on the November ballot. In order to ensure his position on the ballot was secured, our team set a goal of doubling the minimum requirement by today's deadline.

We are thrilled to share with our supporters that we exceeded our goals. **John is on his way to Jefferson City to deliver over 22,500 petitions to the Secretary of State.**

Dear Peter,

I want to hear what you have to say about where our district is at! The Summer is so full of sun and vacation that it's easy to block out the troubles in our country.

It may seem like a lull in the political timeline, but we are in crunch time for fundraising!! We have to get prepared to get the message to voters in October that it's time to send a nurse, not a career politician, to Washington to get things done and heal our nation.

The good news is we have FIVE fundraisers coming up, one in each county. If your county lands on a night you are unavailable, everyone is welcome to attend any or all of the fundraisers.

You can find these under the [events](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=cab1460b1a&e=20ac8f046f) page on my website. You can purchase tickets on the website. Individual links are provided below as needed.

Ticket cost: $75

body:
**[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdb7addb090f4610b2ac8a00099503c0&_e=lPSrXpDMhddKt5oI55PavlBBrEGHXGfqed488Y7qOynerkpS9kh8He06XtUeM8jlj9fwSVzgRx4CmzorSiqfrgHtXVdGBHundTNyHE8k2Pi7kilNzFxpnPuELLqpFffIdrBIuJUAPBin4b4blIwMciAsJ0dNEHUKtSzb46GnYTxO-Rf3JaAhAdC_5PWIZJkH0z7H35aoBU2DJz6bEW7OK62WlSu7_XoFAZD-wjxIqTza3hdtxnHIr00wFGYF-ty-i7mO9V7szeuB_iFE7Cb-KJ2BmqKe4_K2GHbLPfaEX-9jUBHKF63LWW8pGPhNdnbcmQjQoeF8u2bP4vwCq77ZmQ%3D%3D) **
Friend,
I’m truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I’m taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden’s Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left’s destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left’s draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I’m glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That’s why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdb7addb090f4610b2ac8a00099503c0&_e=lPSrXpDMhddKt5oI55PavlBBrEGHXGfqed488Y7qOynerkpS9kh8He06XtUeM8jlj9fwSVzgRx4CmzorSiqfrgHtXVdGBHundTNyHE8k2Pj4mc2I3NPqdV59xN9MYv1fU6wI1XSyPfYimE3htMcNTxaFkwn6SLl-OE3z0ukorXvUxMcV1u7UFYwQanlpEh4AJ7JdLey44kQjCdfllM2zPBI6AVG39_xIru8Dq-_X-i-AFxgupXd11M1wttwLVRBhYKNqvyRmULKCSyvVYziA44rTPdxRKbZwxqVn7V99MTmfKpYIkQWxwa8tDcr5KPSpNF4LU61YhY2IujqzlBRbYQ%3D%3D)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don’t cower with fear about what the media may say — _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida’s 46th Governor, I didn’t let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child’s needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I’ve continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdb7addb090f4610b2ac8a00099503c0&_e=lPSrXpDMhddKt5oI55PavlBBrEGHXGfqed488Y7qOynerkpS9kh8He06XtUeM8jlj9fwSVzgRx4CmzorSiqfrgHtXVdGBHundTNyHE8k2PhaPayggPYwLZD7nTm9ohhuP_vryy-iYLJXuG___2vC8KWvA7Zul1RR8ijknz4ve6QwZlW19E-ZuEVvB4MwrGfLuWpNlrXZdtqkccsz_kPuARIhwedfeBEF26LBv_2NObtrY8f1wTXUs20bhd_gUfqfVFmQEYSEWDCykL8VYEq25SPNrYHSnS44jkYqOWxG4GmijJLjo5ByQzdW8iPzcIsh4i28om4T_j1V-sKSOsjXnA%3D%3D)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don’t set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley’s CEOs, Big Tech’s shady algorithms, or the corrupt media’s agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.
**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**
As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.
I’m proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._
Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.
I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.
**As Governor of Florida, I’ll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation.**
My re-election campaign sent SHOCK WAVES through the Democrat media complex when we announced a $5 MILLION ad reservation targeting Hispanic voters.
With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.
**I’m going to battle for every vote.**
As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!
We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.
Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I’m asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today.
With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift.
[**[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdb7addb090f4610b2ac8a00099503c0&_e=lPSrXpDMhddKt5oI55PavlBBrEGHXGfqed488Y7qOynerkpS9kh8He06XtUeM8jlj9fwSVzgRx4CmzorSiqfrgHtXVdGBHundTNyHE8k2PiLzjhDSQGhfau4ZZxxal4WMZFZKS20uzgzplEWT6k_B6r2t3MchTRoVTbk-7qAqUhaaUCRS5_X9C_7Lguh28LzK8oq49mq26kSKmUH_f_548NMqYhkNv9ta0bPaBlfhL_hn9Qr0g5vjXpcvCfCU6px2LE-UOmBAiVHWlpjjNXX9itY8_uRl4CAu4GFFHAITnFZueNDnUA0gBiPr5h9n-7knMb4evGj2JkikhbwwIxAuQ%3D%3D)
Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me.
_Friend, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support._
No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government.
For Florida,
Ron DeSantis
[DONATE NOW](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdb7addb090f4610b2ac8a00099503c0&_e=lPSrXpDMhddKt5oI55PavlBBrEGHXGfqed488Y7qOynerkpS9kh8He06XtUeM8jlj9fwSVzgRx4CmzorSiqfrgHtXVdGBHundTNyHE8k2Pgy6wNxt2X6mO9BavfWKgdjB6W4CR8o1vw7GlrMIz-77TQO_9o3uFby89SBnD8H9PSrGruvZQ26wWqyswtW7-u7Pd4HtMxZWHdDDaL7CSTl555Y5dcKgjGMlIUsXqTKOwWnzQE_M4XDH-Ua2TOm-CzUnIi4spA5GdpkRNlZr2CVd_KQxkBZ_1EAlnFfJoSBrG7_jf7j7wsbPjW9h8x71g-dkJaiBNKi7WSFED9ulrum9g%3D%3D)

It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments. As Governor of Florida, I’ll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation. I’m going to battle for every vote. As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor! We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight. Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I’m asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today. With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift. [[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]]() Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me. Friend, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support. No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government. body:
Democrats in Pennsylvania must act!
| | | Team, it’s Kati from the DSCC.

It's still sinking in for many of us that the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_. While we knew this decision was more than likely coming, it doesn’t make me any less appalled, devastated and to be frank -- absolutely enraged. And in fact, now that this is _real_ , I feel all of these things now more than ever. But I know I am not alone.

So we cannot stay silent, especially in this moment when this cuts so deep for so many and we’re just plain tired. We must continue to go to the mat to uphold a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions, because we know damn well extremist Republicans are not going to stop here. Mitch McConnell has already said a national abortion ban is “possible” if he takes back our Senate majority.

That’s why we’re calling on Democrats everywhere to sign our urgent petition to stand with _Roe_ , and we need 10,000 signatures from Pennsylvania before 11:59 p.m. Please sign now: **[www.dscc.org/DefendReproductiveRights](https://go.dscc.org/go/8453?ask=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20220801-Kati-RoeOverturnedSMSRef-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20220801-Kati-RoeOverturnedSMSRef-Pros-sl1&akid=5570%2E9716520%2EpYWmUx)**

Thank you for continuing to be in this fight,

Kati

I’m the only Democrat in this race who supports Medicare for All and a Green New Deal. I’m the only Democrat in this race who isn’t taking money from corporate PACs. And I’m never going to stop fighting against the powerful interests who seek to divide us.
**The stakes of this race couldn’t be higher — for our district, and for our democracy.**
You know who’s poured in money to support my opponent? Republican millionaires and billionaires and a group that also supports GOP members of Congress who voted to overturn the 2020 election after the January 6 attacks. Our democracy is on the edge of a cliff, but my opponent refuses to reject support from a group that’s also supporting insurrectionists, for crying out loud.
[**Republican billionaires don’t want me to stay in Congress — but they don’t get the last word here. The voters do. And you can help make sure they hear our message.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48633922/359008242/2045083091?refcode=em_20220730_f_t_al&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzYzZmMyOS1iYjExLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hsOC-lSh2Pd5ezdu1oGkxpnRcbqrCKR1dJ_RrIkbNKA=)

Go down the line: **on issue after issue, from abortion rights to Medicare for All to climate action, right-wing extremists with deep pockets would get to curate the Democratic Party’s agenda.**
And look: We’ve seen an ugly pattern in the past few months, with outside money from right-wing groups swamping strong progressive candidates in Democratic primaries, especially targeting progressive women of color.
But we’ve also seen reason for hope: in some of those races, progressive candidates like Summer Lee have still been able to fight back and WIN. How? Three words: organizing, organizing, organizing.
[**I know we have a pathway to victory through organizing, but I also know it will take some more resources for the final push, so I have to ask again: Can you chip in right away?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48633923/359008243/2045083091?refcode=em_20220730_f_t_al&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzYzZmMyOS1iYjExLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hsOC-lSh2Pd5ezdu1oGkxpnRcbqrCKR1dJ_RrIkbNKA=)
I see it everywhere I go: When people hear about our accomplishments and the bold, progressive change we’re fighting for, they’re excited to join our team, alongside leaders like Elizabeth Warren, Bernie Sanders, and Cecile Richards who’ve endorsed me for reelection.
But we’re at a real risk of being drowned out by all the right-wing outside spending.
So I will be forever grateful for any action you can take in the final day to help fight back, from [**donating money**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48633924/359008244/2045083091?refcode=em_20220730_f_t_al&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzYzZmMyOS1iYjExLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hsOC-lSh2Pd5ezdu1oGkxpnRcbqrCKR1dJ_RrIkbNKA=) as a grassroots donor to donating time as a volunteer.
Peter, I’m not backing down. When I got to Congress, I didn’t settle for incremental change. My family raised me to fight for justice, and I’ve always championed bold policies because of it. The pandemic and the disparities it’s highlighted have made me all the more eager to fight for the fundamental change we need.
I will never waver in doing what is right — whether it’s standing up to insurance companies and Big Pharma as a Medicare for All champion, corporate interests as a union organizer, or oppressive forces at home and abroad as a human rights activist. We need decisive, creative, effective leadership fighting for our families in this moment, and I have the background and record to be that person for our new district.
It would be the honor of my lifetime to represent the new MI-11 — the place I was born and raised and still call my home. But there’s still much more work to be done.
It’s all been leading up to this — an all-out sprint before the polls close at 8:00pm tomorrow.
We can defeat the onslaught of spending from billionaire-funded corporate super PACs with people power.
We can bring about a bright new era of equal rights, reproductive freedom, racial and social and economic justice, good-paying union jobs, clean air, clean water, universal health care, affordable prescription drugs and child care, paid family leave for all — we can do it, as long as we fight for it. Together.
I’m asking one more time: If you can, please make a donation to give this team a boost before tomorrow’s election, and help lead us to victory.
Let’s go!
Andy

| Dear Peter,
Our campaign to Save America is heating up and our America Last opponents are more focused on negative ads then on solutions to fix our nation. But, I know what is needed to fix our economy and fight back against the wokeism that is infecting our nation.
While other candidates talk about what they will do, I have already done it.
---
| | |
---|---
|
As the son of two Navy veterans I know the sacrifices they have made for our country. My late mother Anna, after her service to our country took on another role in serving children with specials needs. Her altruism and compassion for others helped shape me into the man I am today.

One of my most memorable accomplishments was assisting a non-profit organization in District 1 that was seeking to build a new facility to support their therapy programs for children on the spectrum as well as for veterans and women with PTSD. I secured funding to develop a new facility that assists in this important mission of healing.

As your next congressman I will continue to be present in this district and fight hard for children with special needs, and better healthcare for our veterans.

I need your vote on August 23rd!
| We only have 23-days left until our GOP primary and I need your help. My team is fighting hard to get our message out to the voters, but we need more resources to reach the voters in these final weeks. Please be a part of the solutions we need by donating to my campaign.

Peter –
My parents & my faith taught me that when I see something wrong, I need to speak up about it.
Last week, Buddy Carter inserted himself into an Oversight Committee hearing to question Marty Daniel, CEO of Daniel Defense. What followed looked more like an ad spot for Daniel Defense [https://fb.watch/ezw-R5Owhv/] rather than serious questioning from a sitting Congressman.
Buddy isn't a part of this committee – he came in late to slide the Daniel Defense CEO softball questions. Buddy’s performance was a paid advertisement – a career politician taking care of a donor.
Since 2014, Buddy Carter has taken tens of thousands of dollars from Marty Daniel and his wife Cindy Daniel, of Daniel Defense Inc.
In an interview with WJCL later that day, Carter claimed, “I don’t keep up with campaign contributions...”
If someone gave me $30,000, I’d remember it. Buddy knows who his big donors are, and I am sure his donors remind him.
We cannot let this man keep turning his back on this district just so he can line his own pockets. We must retire Buddy Carter on November 8th – and our campaign has a plan to make that happen.
Thank you,
Wade Herring

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: Why I created the BLEXIT Foundation
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znuhlolpu1pe95clfe2ahcrp6ks2kicus3ev340o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2utgr9orn68oeao9m6koe8ohkmji34d1j6dq68s76mdqr5chj66oneo9n69qrcc77q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhmiqjcdtnc5j7appjchjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5cjj61p71c1ge49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2qldnrk7896fgpju49g5r116akqbkfnun7ibsog_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9p94348obubd8h8si3sa3kvd2v6h44malgrutpg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2ggb88jbr6dh9gmodmdsbd914lcrqg7ojgs7p9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zear599dcuj2noeqglea2qb4mvolsp8douighv70_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuadno0t3e9ugrcj3qo8vtcnjo15hgj9hf8ugns0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z40ikrd0igdojn8sc4r4bvdfj9q592u7ge3gao4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv2vm875s91l98csh2muboapvnte0vrtppgeidu0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo9bcfaca0ip4ajlkk0ul67d6v3jgomf0daamldg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zojkuu74nmunof1qv0j779dj6p0lj1rapogi5qkg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl57p9ct37rokaqjjn3ip1jdltp1tjccnsdqmafg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl7hoil7kkg7uluhomcjji546vo9t2vtlom94oho_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zldcdmmalol7i5vmn84vje32l6ods9d9u1qk7i18_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zogbu3oaid8b1jb3rsst9copf6cbksu6gm31a8to_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8t2r4r1pv96ssf9i0lfrh5lr6l2k4qns0s528do_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4iv7mmthph8k0n1fr60q4thdmksagr29e4uikk0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziu8u253o4fapm15ksg1b3t96s7i022rr1cg8kv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi4475v2f4imgl164993nmbfncad2l14joj0ok3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z65poagpqq0n24t2jfkimmlrdmtmocc7sheu34h0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4spge9ob0c3h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

The country has never seen anything like this: $4 million from Dark Money Super PACs has been spent to defeat me within the three-week voting period here in Washington State.

Please help us with an additional contribution today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/P4NviKmuCY3Tw8WlMqcDSg/1D1mRL14wxFV3m6Gd21O892w) so we can keep fighting and push through to victory.
Thank you and God Bless,

Joe Kent

body:
Pray with our team tonight at 9:30 PM

| [ ](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayercall3&n=1)
---
**Join The Prayer Call Tonight** **Tonight, Monday 9:30pm** **Call 605-313-4829** **Then enter 694177#** For anyone who would like to join in Praying and Fasting, we have a team that will be praying and fasting the entire day of the election. Here are some things that we can flood the throne of God with together, as we join together- \- Father, Son Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit, we acknowledge and glorify you as God, we give you Praise. \- We confess our shortcomings, and ask your forgiveness. \- We are SO THANKFUL Lord that you have brought us this far! \- Lord, Ralph meets the qualifications of whom You Lord have said you will look to in Isaiah 66. The one who is humble, contrite in spirit, and trembles at Your Word. Please Lord, as we your people ask in agreement, please listen to the voice of Your children in Michigan as we ask for our choice for Governor in Michigan to be Ralph Rebandt. Lord, the only reason we ask this so passionately of You is that we believe He is Your choice as he meets these qualifications. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven, Lord. We believe You are Able! \- That every heart and every mind that is able to vote will hear about Ralph, and be inclined to vote for him. \- That God would appoint 'an east wind' when the sun rises on election day, bringing about a miraculous win for Ralph on August 2nd, 2022. \- That God would work with wave upon wave in the hearts and minds of each voter, with an overflow of what is needed to win this election. \- That God would use everything- individual efforts, letters to churches, flyers in car handles and windows, commercials, text messages, rallies, people, radio, and Anything else possible to get Ralph to the seat of Governor in Michigan if it is His Will. Ralph desires Psalm 138:2, "Your Name and Your Word you have elevated above all else." \- That the Holy Spirit would make up ALL the difference in our weaknesses in how we do not know how to pray- "Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words." (Romans 8:26) Holy Spirit, please intercede Yourself for us in this area of prayer as you have promised to do. May the Will of the Father be done, in Jesus Name. Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow. Lord, we look to You. In Jesus Name, Amen! Thank you for your continued support. Ralph Rebandt For Governor

(Romans 8:26) Holy Spirit, please intercede Yourself for us in this area of prayer as you have promised to do. May the Will of the Father be done, in Jesus Name. Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow. Lord, we look to You. In Jesus Name, Amen! Thank you for your continued support. Ralph Rebandt For Governor Ralph Rebandt For Governor · MI 48094, United States

**Congressman Chabot Endorsed by America’s Leading Voice for Small Businesses** _Congressman Chabot Working Across Party Lines to Fight Inflation, Supply Chain Pressures, Labor Shortages and Soaring Energy Costs_ _ _**For Immediate Release** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) **CINCINNATI** – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released the following statement on the campaign’s recent endorsement from the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB):

“I am honored to once again receive the confidence and endorsement of the nation’s leading voice for small businesses,” **said Congressman Chabot.** “I’m proud of my track record of working with Republicans and Democrats to deliver results for our small businesses and will continue fighting every day to tackle the unprecedented challenges they face, including record inflation, supply chain pressures, labor shortages, soaring energy costs and more.”

“I’ve advanced bipartisan solutions to lower energy costs, introduced policies to address the supply chain crisis, fought for better trade deals for American businesses and worked to be a champion for small businesses,” **Chabot continued**. “I look forward to continuing to be a champion for the prosperity and success of our small businesses and the families and communities they support.”

“With rampant inflation, massive supply chain disruptions, ever-changing pandemic guidance and a shortage of available workers, small businesses continue to face challenges and setbacks,” **NFIB Senior National Political Director Sharon Sussin said** in a letter announcing the endorsement. “It’s vital that our members can count on candidates like you who will focus on solutions to help the small business recovery.”

body:

| | | | | Peter, Matt Gaetz makes a terrible Congressman, but might make a good mobster. Last time we emailed about Gaetz we told you you he attacked pro-choice women at a right-wing conference, saying as part of his trademark idiocy _" Why is it that women with the least likelihood of getting pregnant are the ones most worried about having abortions."_ Since, a few things have happened. **First, Gaetz was just exposed talking like a mobster on a recording from 2019, referring to Donald Trump as "The Boss" and telling Roger Stone he'd get a pardon on the eve of his 2019 trial where Stone could have implicated Trump (obstruction of justice?). ** _**But...the second update is SO MUCH BETTER.**_ **Julianna Orlanna the**** courageous teenage abortion rights activist, who responded to his indignity by [turning his insult into $460,000 in fundraising for ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2fa945e0-df09-4c0b-b0ba-255ebf6e756d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[_Gen Z For Choice Abortion Fund--_ which splits monies between the 50 states to ensure women who can't afford an abortion don't lose their right to choose](https://default.salsalabs.org/Taf3f81db-32e4-462b-b2e9-a9144bc66046/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), has an update for us.**

---
| **_BREAKING: Olivia Julianna announced she has now raised $2,000,000, all thanks to Matt Gaetz!_** Utterly incredible. **Former Congressman and Texas Gubernatorial candidate, Beto O'Rourke, responded by having Julianna stand up at a speech of his, introducing Julianna as "the future of Texas" and telling everyone what she had done. She, quite naturally, received a standing ovation.** We at Blue Amp Action are also once again inspired by what this amazing young woman has done. _Taking something that could have hurt her and turning it into something that will help so many_. To be so mature at such a young age, while these pathetic men of the Republican Party wander around like lost little boys. [**So will you join me once again, in honor of Julianna, women across the country, and, as a big middle finger to Matt Gaetz, in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Gen Z For Change, so we can help women across the country continue to control of their lives?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6b70d2e3-c850-4548-9776-2e42914b1515/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you as always for all you do to fight for equality in our country. Cliff

Friend,

The Right Thing To Do: the Inflation Reduction Act
Last Friday, Congress took a giant step forward in passing a transformational policy toward improving the lives of everyday Americans with the Inflation Reduction Act . It’s not the Build Back Better Act, but it does:
lower healthcare costs
restore fairness in the tax code
lowers the deficit, and
strengthens our economy
It is also an historic agreement that ensures the United States is poised to take decisive action on the climate crisis and transitions our country to more renewable energy with a $369 billion investment.
Amazing! But you know what I like more than this legislation? How it was done.
It was achieved by hard working congress members and senators who rolled up their sleeves and kept working to find a solution. When Biden’s Build Back Better bill stalled, representatives returned to the negotiating table to make important pieces stick... like the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act , which delivered necessary funding for critical infrastructure investments from roads and bridges, to flood mitigation projects, and even extending broadband connections.
You know what our congressman did? He went home.
And when more is needed to be done to address our climate crisis, we ask our Representatives to keep fighting. I’m proud to be a member of a party that is constantly looking for opportunities to deliver results. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherine-for-congress-1] While the Inflation Reduction Act is now in the Senate’s hands, I expect Democratic leadership in the House to build a coalition of support.
Why? Because it’s the right thing to do.
Listen, we can’t just take our ball and go home when we don’t score, we have to stay and keep fighting until the game is over. And the game is far from over.
If you’re ready to have a Representative who will get things done, send me to Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherine-for-congress-1] My door will always be open.
Catherine

name: Giffords
subject: Sign our petition telling the Senate you support an assault weapons ban.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Last week, the House of Representatives took an important step forward to prevent gun violence and save lives when a bipartisan majority of members voted to ban assault weapons.
#

Friends -
Last week, the House of Representatives took an important step forward to prevent gun violence and save lives when a bipartisan majority of members voted to ban assault weapons and large capacity magazines.
As you know, year after year we’ve seen communities across the country devastated by mass shootings—made deadlier by assault weapons.
Newtown, Las Vegas, Uvalde, Parkland, Buffalo, Highland Park...
These weapons are designed to kill as many people as possible as quickly as possible, and it’s time we stopped allowing people with dangerous intentions to access weapons of war so easily.
We know this bill faces an uncertain future in the Senate.
But because you continued to demand action and support our work, Congress passed the first major piece of gun safety legislation in almost three decades.
So we’re going to continue to fight to make even more progress.
And it all starts with making your voice heard.
Adding your name to our petition is a small and simple action, but it speaks volumes about the size of the movement to get this done. So we’re asking:
[**Can you please use this link to tell the Senate you want them to pass an assault weapons ban to keep dangerous weapons of war off of our streets?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/220801-awb-em/?source=em220801-1-15&refcode2=2270.3935704.p8JdSO&akid=2270%2E3935704%2Ep8JdSO)

Thanks for making your voice heard.
The team at Giffords PAC

We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=2270%2E3935704%2Ep8JdSO) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

name: Dr. Bob
subject: We loved this Tweet
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
Polls open in 12 hours and both peninsulas of Michigan are fired up. Here are two comments that help fuel our campaign.
Good evening,
We equally love both peninsulas, but this Tweet fired up my U.P. field staff.

ALSO THIS -
"I am sure you would be a strong voice for honesty, integrity, and collaboration, which is desperately needed in our Congress. I wish you every possible success in your campaign.
Sincerely,
Debb"
Receiving communication like this is what a winning campaign is all about.
But what are surveys saying about America?
* ## A majority of Americans agree that the government is “corrupt and rigged against everyday people like me.”
* ## Nearly half of Americans agreed that they “more and more feel like a stranger in my own country"
* ## Nearly a third say that “it may be necessary at some point soon for citizens to take up arms against the government"
* ## Majorities of each party hold that members of the other are “generally untruthful and are pushing disinformation"
* ## Half of us “avoided political discussions with others because I don’t know where they stand.”
* ## A quarter reported losing friends over politics.

## _**This must not continue. We will, should, can, and must do better.**_
I will represent all of us. I strive to earn your respect and trust by addressing problems and solutions with facts, not by party. I will respect and listen to those who agree and disagree with me.
I will reach out to all district citizens regardless of party affiliation. I will have town halls open to all. We are one America. We must work together and move forward, or else we will fail. But, with trust and respect for each other, we will succeed and build on this great Nation.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48652170/359057719/1277889215?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzg5YWQ3Mi1lNzExLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WJwXiPkdpFXR7BCwBAwfTItoaP7rnsQtGdubh478G-0=)
Every week, my team has thousands of meaningful conversations with all kinds of voters, from liberals to conservatives and everyone in between.
We are the underdog, but every hardworking 1st District resident knows that's exactly the fuel needed to surmount big obstacles. Through Northern Michigan and UP grit, my goal is to earn voters' respect and trust.
With you in my corner, we can bring ethical and principled leadership back to Michigan's 1st Congressional District.
**Can I count on you to contribute today? The FEC will reset donation limitations on Wednesday at 12 a.m. I am under a deadline to allocate your gift towards our budget as soon as possible.**

Thank you for your support and consideration.

Peter, we are a nation built by immigrants. Nowhere is that clearer than in New York, where _**1 in 4 people**_ are immigrants.
But right now, our fellow New Yorkers need our help: Only a decade after President Obama introduced the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) policy, the GOP might finally succeed in ripping this critical program to shreds.
A conservative panel of judges on the New Orleans federal appeals court is considering arguments about the legality of DACA – and if they decide to rule against the program, the lives of _**over 611,000 Dreamers**_ could be severely altered.

New York alone is home to tens of thousands of DACA recipients – and a future without them is simply unfathomable. DACA recipients are vital to our economy, to our communities, and to our way of life.

In 2021, I led a coalition of 23 attorneys general across the nation to file an amicus brief in support of DACA, but our fight is far from over. Peter, I’m counting on activists like you to join the fight for immigrants rights, so please: Will you take a moment now to answer this quick poll?

body:
Polls open in 12 hours and both peninsulas of Michigan are fired up. Here are two comments that help fuel our campaign.
Good evening,
We equally love both peninsulas, but this Tweet fired up my U.P. field staff.

ALSO THIS -
"I am sure you would be a strong voice for honesty, integrity, and collaboration, which is desperately needed in our Congress. I wish you every possible success in your campaign.
Sincerely,
Debb"
Receiving communication like this is what a winning campaign is all about.
But what are surveys saying about America?
* ## A majority of Americans agree that the government is “corrupt and rigged against everyday people like me.”
* ## Nearly half of Americans agreed that they “more and more feel like a stranger in my own country"
* ## Nearly a third say that “it may be necessary at some point soon for citizens to take up arms against the government"
* ## Majorities of each party hold that members of the other are “generally untruthful and are pushing disinformation"
* ## Half of us “avoided political discussions with others because I don’t know where they stand.”
* ## A quarter reported losing friends over politics.

## _**This must not continue. We will, should, can, and must do better.**_
I will represent all of us. I strive to earn your respect and trust by addressing problems and solutions with facts, not by party. I will respect and listen to those who agree and disagree with me.
I will reach out to all district citizens regardless of party affiliation. I will have town halls open to all. We are one America. We must work together and move forward, or else we will fail. But, with trust and respect for each other, we will succeed and build on this great Nation.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48652218/359057884/1277889215?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTdiNjBjZS1lNzExLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pnmg8k_GD-vwZXVGBbtSGsdShoJ-k8pAu7KN5xfVEGs=)
Every week, my team has thousands of meaningful conversations with all kinds of voters, from liberals to conservatives and everyone in between.
We are the underdog, but every hardworking 1st District resident knows that's exactly the fuel needed to surmount big obstacles. Through Northern Michigan and UP grit, my goal is to earn voters' respect and trust.
With you in my corner, we can bring ethical and principled leadership back to Michigan's 1st Congressional District.
**Can I count on you to contribute today? The FEC will reset donation limitations on Wednesday at 12 a.m. I am under a deadline to allocate your gift towards our budget as soon as possible.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48652219/359057885/1277889215?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTdiNjBjZS1lNzExLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pnmg8k_GD-vwZXVGBbtSGsdShoJ-k8pAu7KN5xfVEGs=)
Thank you for your support and consideration.
Best Regards,
Dr. Bob

But we have another tough reelection battle ahead of us, and I’ll need you by my side every step of the way. The NRCC has named me a top target in their fight to flip the House majority, and they’ve already begun to launch attacks at our campaign. And as a result of our state’s redistricting process, 70% of the voters we’ll be talking to in our district are brand new, and have never had my name on their ballot before. I’ll be honest, winning this election won’t be a walk in the park. It will take a lot of resources to expand our outreach efforts and spread our message to new voters, all while fighting back against right-wing attacks. But I’ve seen what this team is capable of, and together, I know we can overcome these new challenges and make history once again. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Lauren Underwood and Lisa Blunt Rochester: | | **= | | = | = | | = | = | | = Thanks for reading and chipping in, if you can. subject: Progressives: Don't miss this discount
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
Dear Friend,

Not sure if you saw, but the 17th annual Netroots Nation conference is coming to Pittsburgh August 18-20, and I’m planning to be there!

Join me at the largest annual progressive gathering in the country to learn, connect, and be inspired.

With more than 140 hours of programming, Netroots Nation features inspiring keynotes (Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar and Ed Gainey are just a few of the confirmed speakers), engaging panels, cutting-edge training sessions, and opportunities to connect with progressive activists from across the country.

There’s a discounted rate for locals, too.

Register now and get 40% off of any ticket level. [https://registration.socio.events/e/netroots22/promo-codes/PGHLOCALS]

Need a scholarship or interested in volunteering? Click here to apply for one or to sign up. [https://www.netrootsnation.org/faq/scholarships/]

This year's agenda includes conversations about the upcoming midterms and strategies to win ; conversations about protecting our democracy ; and sessions digging into pressing issues—from abortion access and policing to climate change and gun reform . There’s also tons of content highlighting the organizing and activism happening in Pittsburgh and throughout the state.

Here’s just a few of the locals-led, Pennsylvania-focused panels on the agenda:

Why We're Winning: How Black-Led Progressive Organizations are Changing the Face of Western PA Politics [https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/why-were-winning-how-black-led-progressive-organizations-are-changing-the-face-of-western-pa-politics/]

Public Safety vs. Policing: They are Not One and the Same! [https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/public-safety-vs-policing-they-are-not-one-and-the-same/]

Pennsylvania’s Plan to Take on the Corporations Harming Our Democracy [https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/pennsylvanias-plan-to-take-on-the-corporations-harming-our-democracy/]

Building a Movement for Gun Violence Prevention [https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/building-a-movement-for-gun-violence-prevention/]

The Intersections of the Supreme Court's Decision on Abortion Rights [https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/the-intersections-of-the-supreme-courts-decision-on-abortion-rights/]

Cross Culture Collaboration in Times of Crisis [https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/cross-culture-collaboration-in-times-of-crisis/]
You can peek at the full agenda here [https://www.netrootsnation.org/agenda/] (speakers and sessions are being added every day) and see what others have to say [https://www.netrootsnation.org/testimonials/] about attending Netroots Nation.

Connecting at Netroots Nation will provide the inspiration and energy we all need to keep doing our important work. And given the recent Supreme Court rulings, current events, and upcoming midterms, it’s more important than ever.

I hope to see you there!

Laura Nevitt
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

The bill is a huge step forward for working families across the country as it addresses climate, health care, and tax policy reforms. But the bill’s future hinges on Kyrsten Sinema , who can single-handedly kill the reconciliation deal. And as of today, she still hasn’t voiced her support for the bill. Kyrsten Sinema already killed Build Back Better, but we’re not going to let her screw this up and stall progress once again. Working families deserve better. Arizonans deserve better. That’s why we’ve been turning up the heat on Sinema as soon as the reconciliation deal news broke last week. Friend, yesterday marked our July fundraising deadline. I am so thankful to say that – with your help – we managed to meet and exceed our goal.

Since our district was redrawn, we knew this race would be competitive. With the start of the general election, we have seen my Republican challenger raise hundreds of thousands of dollars to take me down. But, despite the attacks being thrown at me from the right, our movement is stronger than ever thanks to supporters like you.

The people of VA-10 want leaders who will fight to lower the cost of living, protect the right to choose, and preserve the tenets of our democracy. **I am proud to be a voice for the people in each of those fights.**

I am so grateful for all of the support I have received this past month. Thanks to supporters like you, we are building a movement that can meet the challenges ahead and win this November to help retain our House majority.

Thank you so much,

Jennifer | **Rep. Jennifer Wexton proudly serves the 10th District of Virginia. name: Laura Loomer
subject: Attacked by my own Party!
body:
Over the weekend, voters around my district began receiving calls that we call "push polls". They're disguised as polls, but they are designed to influence voters with negative information about a candidate.
****
| | | **[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/m02D763q935Vao9mn17pS3ig/MQx3eKLMFFmTFPa50bpmYw)**
Patriot,

[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/m02D763q935Vao9mn17pS3ig/MQx3eKLMFFmTFPa50bpmYw) Over the weekend, voters around my district began receiving calls that we call "push polls".

They're disguised as polls, but they are designed to influence voters with negative information about a candidate.

And you won't believe what they said about me!

The "pollsters" falsely stated that I'm:

• Pro-Nancy Pelosi
• Pro-BLM
• Anti-Ron DeSantis
• and Anti-Trump

If that's not laughable enough, the fake pollsters also said horrible things about my amazing campaign manager and stated that I've received "over 1 billion in campaign money from 'sketchy' businesses." **Literally unbelievable!**

What they didn't state in their fake poll was that I'm an investigative journalist . . . **and a good one!**

After a little digging, we found that the hit piece robocalls and fake poll was conducted by a digital marketing company called Dynata, LLC.

Derek —

It’s no secret that Wisconsin is one of Democrats’ top pickup
opportunities in the Senate this fall, and today, I’m asking for you to
join me in supporting Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes. Mandela can — and simply
must — win this race.

Mandela, the son of a public school teacher and third-shift auto worker,
is an incredible candidate. He’s built a grassroots coalition to win this
seat, with deep ties dating back from his time as a community organizer
and state legislator, to now as Lieutenant Governor.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em_barnes.tRfHqv&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220801_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=589%2E5257348%2Eoucxns ][IMG]

of the worst of the worst GOP Senators.

Because it would take way too long to read about all of his many
destructive and delusional actions, here are just a few of the things
Johnson’s done recently:

Johnson has purposefully spread COVID misinformation, peddled Trump’s Big
Lie about the election, and even went on Fox News to cover for Donald
Trump’s extortion of Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, an offense for which
Trump was impeached, by blaming Putin’s invasion on... me. Yeah, I know.
Delusional. And that’s just in the last few years.

Yep, he’s that kind of Senator. And he’s gotta go.

Mandela, on the other hand, is campaigning on abolishing the filibuster to
reestablish voting rights, taking on the gun lobby to protect our
communities and schools, and codifying Roe v. Wade as federal law.

Republicans know Johnson is in trouble, which is why Mitch McConnell and
his allies are investing tens of millions of dollars in Wisconsin to shore
up his sagging poll numbers, which show Mandela neck-and-neck in this
race.

gamechanger. That’s why I’m asking:

subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9ufgzsCsFGktwNLYJquqaH2c3isLfWzngxTkI6b3S3nIsT59e5c5IbmV6L9qa-e2rDSSIh2Jb4BB-LBev4KoKmVAV32cCMOXkxMzWG8k4IuMkoK5kIoSdo4BNb18Ld4Vx0ZSxnmWSJDpMBbLZCIlYE8Lz5SKCIyC6rYMgzqnSWEtCqXJIWFSomnDXMCAjvB59haWFqj4E--UrYLT65voyFk%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9sPjD8mt-GHg6U_NtuTx94XIZpuEKZN_Ra8mL7qCJcxgrJN8DowgdjXSQw4YqFM-jUHWxuufwcMneqTF1-g2gAz_0rEtEHga6ZiF1ASgnjQ0Xq8Y78BoKZowPQg6LL21Vw7LCOkwGPvS8s1AXBBzbwacEYtVBp07ZT0i_9T5o9hpZ87afxBlVAZYe6c0h6DMhLtnndgBxVWxEQsGpOND-74%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9uUq30WCK1IW0toMwYJBV7uU_R8R08xGustH8zVIoKj_St9zlJrdU6lLMerb14VCZVp7x5lkBP9BkPmz5oNyTQxOT5c8lEiLixr9q7rwQxotILO5GkrG6Cxdat1-qs9WrSYoQ2ELZN5UvdTe2Jxl_OYPv-BlPW-Nj-YbpjNUwRFk3XFIta4PxX5sYJaknZQtiYNNtN_fCIyzB1JpzZQDMr8%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9is0Ipv5u-F8DY0FuyNhfW7JdylJ-8o1JEjqlIlEOWcoewjzfIZPDXf2oX5GxlRbKTyctegz3FlVDWOBvuD2-SxtVH5J-x-MsPkfpAQX_9tfFSS1mv9XxpMfGC2xqJKeydC4zJTMLr2e5QnBkGP_Q19IkF9pV000yfi1dSWXrw9dWBTY2aOBTmoReO9msFkri2fhTLC9kva1gb_CvbaPCc0%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9gXFiD-irYuJe4HNXEIM7pi4u7SuWtGPmFkaNLuzOQcjKUFnU6XriShKZAsQ9jhNaXFfA8s2VTNkZksibNSN7FL_WxkhC4T1vHQXdWKaVO83-qcplTMuBY7SiEr3aNH1zl4i9h6WZqRwTW7JHTZdPZlrMdQCD1lAV9ydlm9-a2yDc_YKn5mQrLFHNT9UYfEnyDKQdf8RL2Fn0Qo39_xoLCA%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9t033Uwj1EefbhAndO4KTdU9OmTUJE8Az6wwmqTDT3NrqhbytuSHUxUgrLuTxuRmAlPih7FG5IhgZ4fSeLVBG3ODtGN0GCiTtRx4BBPDDjD0ovgXCSYus9-VOeQT10lOdX_Guxj7eW9qh8cV-QneZO_daP1KSQXEl2FQIUTxpqM8a-ZjItmVgVFjT5JV8o5Eq5WJLB_phT2XBrL_lAPm_Ro%3D)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9sTG3nXqdKW13G4Kjo8P3SVYZcWTEn2QPgj3TDQIwUGaQXdF9c8xPadi9mjAapNl9H7CXEmKzeBjWnshOCKkmKMlCmhggfVTNHyu_tkmM9o2oaq-DMhcruLMsdHr_hZrhGLS5N-VghhAsJpOf8BldmBNpxaENqJ9V8PotOnKYvyZQzk3bbDNiJeH8jQ-KRVoVn9Gez88Ll63kvVI6PQzB-M%3D)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT’s events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3d3f1f9cc4c44029dec39c0566d118f&_e=8sGV9PclQIU4Ie8H0_6HjeRF-5phfjcCU2xSo9aYIakR8QprTxHPszIV10kLqNWOvaSTEaY06VvZ6iJ_zyX2qvIwBo1i9lAp-lvUmf5FHuSyjBo6vMFe8s00o9iztf_iwjWos2tFvpytfDz3njsY9kb8sfr-d1X6P2uZsE8lNE4SDuIefgvsX6CH9MFglJCMpELz65JoWky9jlwAEfjISaUXnegpVPU5m4SDiaZEOWZm4JW0Uw0--lyMKyNofIr2fEH_g2B4K897WyHme92eRDPUkQVddExjFgSLJVplnX9HpoWssEN19jDkNqBsTGThzXfFf3G-FCXUHsROomCNBD_KwnWvYNZotQOFVJuuFbs%3D)

What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

clean_body: Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I’ll share my story ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I’ve dealt with racism... I’ve even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I’m not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend.
