| If you need any further evidence that Nancy Mace is not the “moderate” she brands herself as, here’s what happened over the weekend:

**Nancy Mace just voted NO on a measure that would ban assault-style weapons and help protect our kids from gun violence.**

While families are being gunned down with weapons of war, Mace has once again shown which side she’s on— _and it’s not the Lowcountry’s._

As a physician, I’ve seen too many children in the hospital suffering from gunshot wounds—I don’t have the luxury of looking away.

**Mace, with her recent votes and statements, is clear on what she believes... life starts at conception and ends at the hands of an assailant with a weapon of war.**

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Insider News from the Political Revolution!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Manchin Deal? | Bernie Rally w/ Andy + Rashida - Vote Tues! |
Ilhan Omar Joins Call | Big Money vs. Andy Levin | Bust Big Tech | Vote
Cori Bush Tues | Climate Heat on Schumer, Biden | NY Senate Races | MD -
Ruth Wins/Elrich Down by 21 | Ohio Party Races |& MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1011&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

As details emerge, the latest version of President Biden’s agenda - The
Inflation Reduction Act - is a far cry from the action needed to meet this
moment, but we’re muscling for as much as possible now to crack the door
open for more.

The battle for any budget deal with Joe Manchin is only alive still
because of massive activism and pressure from our progressive movement.

Our Revolution’s strong state and national networks have also been
critical counter forces against sabotage from corporate Dems like US Rep.
Josh Gottheimer in this process.

As a result, some key investments in renewable energy remain for 40%
carbon reduction by 2030 — along with corporate taxes, tax loophole
closures, Medicare drug price reforms, and other meaningful steps we can
build on, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6174?t=1012&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]The Lever reports.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5972?c0=OR_EM_NEWS_90DO_20220801_1_1.1X1IJS&t=1013&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Become a recurring monthly donor to Our Revolution to maximize our
collective action against far-right authoritarians and mega-corporations
corrupting our politics. Now is the time to fight.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1014&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

BERNIE RALLIES w/ ANDY LEVIN + RASHIDA TLAIB

MICHIGAN, MISSOURI AND OTHERS VOTE TUESDAY!

Our Revolution joined Bernie Sanders to rally the progressive movement in
Michigan to VOTE for US Reps. Andy Levin (MI-11) and Rashida Tlaib
(MI-12)!

It was a great night in Pontiac, MI rallying against big money from
rightwing billionaires trying to defeat two of our most committed
progressive allies and halt their work in Congress for Medicare for All, a
Green New Deal, labor rights and more.

“The billionaire class is saying: ‘We own this country and we will not
tolerate dissent. Work for us or get out,’” Bernie told the crowd. “Andy
Levin has chosen not to work for them, and based on his work deserves to
be re-elected. We must tell them they can’t buy our democracy!”

Hundreds of us are knocking doors, making calls, and activating folks to
the polls for Andy and Rashida by Election Day on Tuesday (Aug. 2). If
you’re in Michigan, make a plan to vote — [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6175?t=1015&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]find your polling place here!

Read more about these races below!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1016&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

ENDORSEMENTS

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1017&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

US Rep. Ilhan Omar has the full support of Our Revolution and Bernie
Sanders in her bid for re-election to Congress in Minnesota’s 5th
District!

Ilhan has been a leading national voice for the progressive movement and
serves as whip for the Congressional Progressive Caucus.

On our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6176?t=1018&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]National Organizing Call on Monday she said: “This is a very
heavy time, a very dangerous moment. A lot of work is being done in the
House, but we have a Senate where every good idea dies.”

“That’s why we protested the Supreme Court’s decision overturning Roe and
got arrested — we have to keep this issue in the spotlight and move with
urgency,” she said.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1019&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

Ilhan said progressives in Congress are actively pushing the president for
executive actions for abortion access, climate action, canceling student
debt, and more.

“We’re pressing forward,” she said. “I know people are tired of being
asked to vote, but we need the right people in the right offices for the
right legislation to pass.”

Ilhan called us to out-organize big money interests targeting progressives
like her across the country. “The onslaught of dangerous TV ads is a
detriment, so we truly appreciate you all being foot soldiers and having
conversations with people.”

Sign up to make calls and send Ilhan reinforcements to join her in
Congress as part of our 2022 Phonebank Force!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4329?t=1020&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]PHONEBANK FOR PROGRESSIVES

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1021&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

Our Revolution is also proudly backing progressive champion Sarah Blas for
NYS Senate in District 23.

Last year, Sarah was elected to the Community Education Council (D-31),
and now she’s running for State Senate to carry on her fight for digital
equity, education, housing, healthcare and more.

Sarah’s first home in Staten Island was a domestic violence shelter before
her family moved into New York City Housing, where she remains a proud
resident — and she’d be the first member of the state legislature to live
in NYCHA.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1022&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

Sarah believes legislation should be crafted by those who are most
impacted by the outcomes.

“Our lived experience matters, it’s time we say no to elected officials
raising money from corporations,” Sarah said on Monday’s [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6158?t=1023&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]National
Organizing Call. “We need folks who will show up where it counts.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1024&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Sign up to help GOTV for Sarah Blas and other great Our Revolution
candidates in NY like Melanie D’Arrigo and Brittany Ramos DeBarros ahead
of the Aug. 23rd election!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1025&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

Gustavo Rivera has Our Revolution’s endorsement for re-election to the NY
State Senate in District 33.

Sen. Rivera has been a great progressive ally in his time in office so
far. Most importantly, as chair of the Senate Health Committee, he is a
main sponsor and steadfast champion of the New York Health Act — which
would create a system of universal, single-payer healthcare in the state.

New York Progressive Action Network (NYPAN) - Our Revolution’s State
chapter - is also working to re-elect Gustavo. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6144?t=1026&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Join our Bronx Chapter
and help get out the vote ahead of NY’s second primary of 2022 on Aug.
23rd!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1027&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

CLIMATE RALLY w/ ANDY LEVIN

Our Revolution joined US Rep. Andy Levin on Monday for a rally and climate
canvas in Michigan’s 11th district, where he’s on the ballot Tuesday for
re-election.

Our Revolution Michigan leader and DNC Climate Council Chair Michelle
Deatrick spoke at the event on the need for collective action in
partnership with elected allies like Andy, who was an original cosponsor
of the Green New Deal.

Last week, Andy was arrested alongside 17 Congresswomen demonstrating for
women’s rights outside the Supreme Court and again the next day with
unionizing cafeteria workers at the US Senate.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5529?t=1028&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Andy Levin is the REAL DEAL. Join the Our Revolution call team to GOTV
tonight in Michigan!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1029&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

$3.3M in attack ads are flooding the airwaves against US Rep. Andy Levin,
paid for by rightwing billionaire-funded superPACs like AIPAC’s “United
Democracy Project” — which is supporting 109 insurrectionists!

A veteran labor organizer, Andy’s inside-outside governing with working
people has made him a target of corporate spending. It has also made him
“by far the best labor member of the House and a progressive with an
amazing environmental record,” Our Revolution Chair Larry Cohen told
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6177?t=1030&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]The Nation.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1031&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

The top issues driving Democratic voters right now include rising prices,
abortion rights, gun violence and threats to democracy, but AIPAC - the
top spender in Democratic primaries, is singularly focused on Israel,
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6178?t=1032&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Politico reports.

Yet, AIPAC rarely mentions Israel in their barrage of ads — spending $22M
this cycle so far against candidates like Rashida Tlaib, Cori Bush, Nina
Turner, Jessica Cisneros, and others.

The SuperPAC takes massive amounts from Trump-aligned billionaires and
says it’s now setting its sights on New York, where Our Revolution
candidates are on the ballot Aug. 23rd.

“That people with vast resources can come in and, for a million dollars a
week, run unaccountable dark money to try to change the outcome of a
Democratic primary — it’s a real threat to our democracy,” Andy said.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6179?t=1033&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Not all Democrats are alike, as billionaire donors and corporate
interests are well aware. Our movement also knows what’s at stake — join
us to fight back.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1034&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

VOTE FOR CORI BUSH TUESDAY!

Tuesday is a big election day in Missouri, too, with progressive champion
Cori Bush (MO-1) on the ballot for re-election!

In 2020, Our Revolution members and volunteers worked to help Cori defeat
10-term corporate incumbent Lacy Clay. Since then, Rep. Bush has been a
steadfast progressive ally in Congress.

“If we want a brighter future for our country and our world, we need to
make change that people can feel,” Cori told us on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6172?t=1035&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]National
Organizing Call. “We build power by getting more of us in there who are
willing to put our minds, our bodies and our reputations on the line to
deliver equity and justice for our communities.”

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1036&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

WINS + SUPER-CLOSE RACES IN MARYLAND

Mail-in ballots are still being counted in Maryland, but Our Revolution
Baltimore Co-Chair Sheila Ruth (D-44B) has won her Baltimore County race
for a full-term in the House of Delegates!

The contest for Montgomery County Executive is a dead heat. Long-time Our
Revolution Maryland member Marc Elrich, who is seeking re-election, trails
Big Pharma CEO David Blair by 21 votes with votes remaining to be tallied
and a recount likely.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1037&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

Our Revolution Maryland is celebrating Brooke Lierman’s win in the
Comptroller’s race as well as the victories of two State Organizing
Committee members - Carlos Childs and Ed Fischman - for Democratic Central
Committee seats in Charles and Montgomery counties.

And, many of the most progressive General Assembly members are winning or
have won. Congratulations to Sens. Jill Carter and Clarence Lam and Dels.
Gabe Acevero, Julie Palakovich-Carr, Lorig Charkoudian, Jessica Feldmark,
David Moon, Emily Shetty, Jared Solomon, Vaughn Stewart, and Jheanelle
Wilkins.

Michelle Gregory running for State Senate, and Todd Nock running for
Delegate, won primary races, and Baltimore City nominated Mark Edelson for
State Delegate.

In County Council primaries, Izzy Patoka won handily in Baltimore Co. Liz
Walsh and Joan Pontius prevailed in Howard Co. In Montgomery Co., Natali
Fani-González won in District 6 and progressive activist Kristin Minkis
almost certain to win in District 5. Krystal Oriadhaheads to the general
in Prince George’s Co.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1038&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

We’re still stacking up major progressive wins for Congress in the 2022
primaries: Greg Casar (TX-35), Summer Lee (PA-12), Jasmine Crockett
(TX-30), Jamie McLeod Skinner (OR-5), Andrea Salinas (OR-6), Delia Ramirez
(IL-3) and Jonathan Jackson (IL-1), and others!

Plus, we have more chances to elect more allies in primary races in
Michigan, Missouri, New York, Vermont, and other states in coming weeks.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6191?t=1039&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Become a recurring donor TODAY to help us take down the worst
corporate Dems and give voters the most electable AND progressive
candidates in November!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1040&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

This 2022 primary season, Our Revolution Phonebank Force has made more
than 500,000 phone calls to voters across the country! We’re recruiting as
many folks as possible to hit that one-million mark and beyond!

Right now, we have shifts for incredible candidates for Congress like
Brittany Ramos-DeBarros (NY-11), Andy Levin (MI-11), David Segal (RI-2),
Melanie D’Arrigo (NY-3), and many others!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4329?t=1041&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]COMMIT TO A CALL SHIFT

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1042&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1043&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

CALLING OUT CHUCK SCHUMER BRING ANTITRUST BILLS TO A VOTE!

Our Revolution activists protested with allies outside a Chuck Schumer’s
fundraiser on Tuesday demanding the Senate Majority Leader bring two
passable antitrust bills for a vote ASAP.

The American Innovation and Choice Online Act and the Open App Markets Act
would help bust Big Tech monopoly power, enable fairer competition on
platforms, and ban self-dealing.

Schumer hid out inside the DC hotel and later dodged us out a back door.
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6181?t=1044&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]NY POST reported: “The unusual game of cat-and-mouse featured
advocates from Fight for the Future, Our Revolution, the American Economic
Liberties Project and Demand Progress — one dressed up as Mr. Monopoly
with a $100M faux check for “Protecting Big Tech.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1045&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

We’re driving so many calls to Schumer, he shut off the voicemail at his
DC office — very democratic of him. So NOW we’re calling his NY office,
and we need you to help us flood that inbox demanding he do his job and
bring antitrust bills for a vote on the Senate floor.

Click [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6182?t=1046&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]this link and it will automatically call your phone and connect
you with Schumer’s office — leave a message, it’s easy and satisfying!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6182?t=1047&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]CALL CHUCK SCHUMER NOW

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1048&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

STAFFERS TURN UP CLIMATE HEAT ON SCHUMER, BIDEN

Speaking of Schumer - 16 congressional staffers of progressive House
members held a sit-in at his DC office on Monday, demanding climate action
from the Senate Majority Leader, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6183?t=1049&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]Axios reports.

Schumer had six of the staffers arrested, but one of their demands - to
reopen climate talks with Manchin - actually materialized two days later!

“I’m not just supportive, I’m damn proud of the staff who were arrested
protesting Schumer’s office for climate,” Ilhan Omar said on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6184?t=1050&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]live
broadcast on Monday.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6185?t=1051&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]The Lever reports a total of 165 staffers at federal health and
environmental agencies and 75 congressional offices issued a [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6186?t=1052&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]letter to
both Schumer and President Biden urging more aggressive tactics before
it’s too late.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1053&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

Our Revolution is part of a large chorus of progressives and
environmentalists demanding Biden declare a Climate Emergency and take
executive action.

We want to hear from you! How many yachts for Joe Manchin are worth the
millions of deaths from impending climate catastrophe? What will future
generations curse us for the most?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/change_the_party/?t=1054&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]TAKE OUR CLIMATE SURVEY

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1055&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6173?t=1056&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ][IMG]

Charly Carter of Democracy Initiative joined our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6158?t=1057&akid=3222%2E5885482%2EgjCCoj ]National Organizing
Call on Monday to lay out a path toward reversing “a well-coordinated,
well-funded multi-prong attack on our rights.”

Democracy Initiative is a coalition of 75 national organizations from
every corner of the movement - labor, civil rights, environmental justice,
women’s rights, and more - coming together to expand our democracy for a
government that works for all of us.

The outrage of the Uvalde shooting forced 15 Republicans to vote for the
first gun legislation in decades. “That’s a roadmap to filibuster changes,
abortion rights and more,” Charly said. “We see a crack and now we keep

We must win tomorrow, but we also must continue our work to protect the Democratic majority in November.
#
Pramila’s primary is tomorrow and we’re working hard to contact voters who haven’t yet returned their ballots. But it’s not _only_ about tomorrow, Peter.
**We must win tomorrow, and we also must continue our work to protect the Democratic majority in November.** We must elect more people-first progressives to build support for Medicare for All and other transformative policies. And we must continue our advocacy work right now to invest in clean energy, health care, and taxing corporations.
[**Peter, can you chip in today to fuel Pramila’s re-election campaign and all of her work for the people? Our campaign is funded by grassroots donations, not corporate PACs.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14635?refcode=em20220801-1476&t=1&akid=1476%2E420207%2EzxFGxh)

That’s why Pramila is working on her re-election campaign AND supporting Democrats in tough swing district races. Team Jayapal

Vote Yes on Value Them Both! _**

Tracey Mann

For too long, politics at the Statehouse have been dominated by Republican leadership who would rather put their own pocketbooks and those of their wealthy friends ahead of the needs of Ohio families.

**[We’ve set a goal of 250 more grassroots donations before our next filing deadline on August 3 – now we need your help to make it happen. They’re leaving because our leadership isn’t putting us first – Republicans are too busy giving tax breaks to the wealthiest few while Ohio's working families struggle to make ends meet.

But we can’t do it with Mike DeWine at the helm.

Nan Whaley

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: I’m enormously grateful for you
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
With hard work and faith, we can move mountains and deliver real change for our families.
#
I just wanted to reach out to say thank you.
We just closed the books on July, and I’m enormously grateful for all of the ways this team stepped up to help us finish the month strong.
I know we asked a lot of this team ahead of last night’s fundraising deadline, but thanks to our grassroots supporters, we are in a strong position for the 99-day sprint ahead.
As I said when we launched this campaign, we have to work harder than we ever have to flip this seat, and the truth is the challenges only get bigger from here. But with hard work and faith, we can move mountains and deliver real change for our families.
We know that corrupt insiders and corporate special interests will do whatever they can to stop us. They are afraid of a senator who will challenge the broken status quo to demand better for our families.
The stakes are high, but together, we can secure the change that our country desperately needs. We will not standby as our democracy, our planet and our rights are at risk — while giant corporations and the ultra-wealthy make record profits.
Thank you again for everything you do. With your help, I know we can win, and when we do, I will be a champion for you and your family.
\- Cheri
If you didn’t have a chance to contribute last month, will you chip in today to help us kick off August? There are less than 100 days until Election Day, so we need all hands on deck!

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: I'm endorsing Kai Kahele for Hawaiʻi Governor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220801-3266-header&t=1&akid=3266%2E2526796%2EzWyoBf)
There are more fights than just congress. I’ve always encouraged people to find a local race they care about — a race that fights for working families and marginalized communities on the ground and isn’t afraid to take on the biggest challenges.
That’s why I’m endorsing my colleague, Kai Kahele, as he returns home to Hawaiʻi, his _ʻohana_ (family), and his community to run for governor. And I’m encouraging folks to support him, too.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220801.zcImNd&refcode=em20220801-3266-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3266%2E2526796%2EzWyoBf)
**Kai is a Native Hawaiian running in the primary for governor. He’s up against an established career politician who has taken enormous corporate money from outside Hawaiʻi, including corporate developers, big tobacco, big pharmaceuticals, and the fossil fuel industry. Kai has pledged to reject all corporate money — and take no more than $100 from individual donors.**
The stakes for Hawaiʻi couldn’t be higher, as they face an immediate housing crisis, [a polluted aquifer from the US Navy](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14785?t=3&akid=3266%2E2526796%2EzWyoBf), ongoing exploitative tourism, and devastating impacts from climate change. **It’s time for Hawaiʻi to be led by people who understand their communities and are from their community** — not bought-out politicians who will continue to sell Hawaiʻi to the highest bidder.
Kai is running a true, grassroots movement powered off small dollar donations. He’s a champion of our working families, marginalized communities, and Native Hawaiians. He will fight for Hawaiʻi’s local working families and stand up to the outside influences that have controlled Hawaiʻi for far too long.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220801.zcImNd&refcode=em20220801-3266-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3266%2E2526796%2EzWyoBf) | [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220801.zcImNd&refcode=em20220801-3266-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=3266%2E2526796%2EzWyoBf)
---|---
I encourage you all to check out Kai’s website, [HawaiiNotForSale.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14786?t=6&akid=3266%2E2526796%2EzWyoBf), and [consider a small dollar donation between $1 to $100 to help his campaign return Hawaiʻi to their local, working people.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220801.zcImNd&refcode=em20220801-3266-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=3266%2E2526796%2EzWyoBf)
_With aloha,_
AOC

body:
**[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=bae8239d4206414fae0e82929abd2187&_e=oDnrlC6v65Q5eFE5Dr-i3KBxg9cdyz89nihQrqxJU_7Ybo0kjtBlamVxwnli2OLzW-nO_GKXrI9lm_rdQT4sdP-u17xpFgthyNXUU_h3hOlY-VIbyD-wCG6v5CZt5NIgtUvn6CvGKqToIRrhUxgBEz0SAnxy83XhIOGZGk0rCAvyN9rGi5npMJHo1w1BWsKUi7Aum-Yn-zpRybIEp6DMLnkfE1LuMtRhhkqMD4gp3kOLUwr8LsHQixsicRDRnPJUKjd6kzu5DZBdW8TH1i-L9QnTD5hVXoKhUTwKHpzDICZhgPy4vL21wMfkqEKwIOsIT8gfdqsQs1XA15AJC84BVYex4phLxkd9ckcVX6QfAa_iGdu277UnmqHlX10zy9H7EG5SkeNPfRTdq3ui1-6tGA%3D%3D)**

Peter,

If the past two years have taught us anything, it's that the Left will stop at _**nothing **_to control you. Fewer rights for you means more power for them, and that is _**exactly what they are after.**_

We saw it clear as day with blue state governors and their response to COVID: Shut everything down. Keep kids out of school. Keep businesses closed. Keep people masked.

**In Florida, we did things differently.**

We stood up against the corporate media, against bureaucrats like Fauci, and against Brandon himself. We kept the state of Florida open to protect people's jobs, to save businesses, and to _**Keep Florida Free.**_

I didn't do this because there was something in it for me. _**I did it because it was the right thing to do.**_ And that's what leadership is all about -- doing what is right. Unfortunately, in today's political environment, true leadership is hard to come by. But it is also needed now more than ever.

**[[KEEP FLORIDA FREE]](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=bae8239d4206414fae0e82929abd2187&_e=oDnrlC6v65Q5eFE5Dr-i3KBxg9cdyz89nihQrqxJU_7Ybo0kjtBlamVxwnli2OLzW-nO_GKXrI9lm_rdQT4sdP-u17xpFgthyNXUU_h3hOlY-VIbyD-wCG6v5CZt5NIgtUvn6CvGKqToIRrhUxgBEz0SAnxy83XhIOGZGk0rCAvyN9rGi5npMJHo1w1BWsKU3ETxv_PBXnbsAeBNZAtuqbI51pAJKNxyylJg4kkKMQtccYBvYPc3A3-hvr6IqQJmDdNHnykMURghCoeD2RIx-apsYy1Hj6n35LxkWatpvOP7ryN3Ik8_GwSz7uoHFNwueOykJNMAjVDop3y1ZFmMEgHkyC6yc3cs54g-hL9OPFM53K-wsMO4v7GUpErQ1Ia97-x_BVhkOB-EdDC-ZRAL3g%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=7e8580675b2851be63f2774bc305ca8f48fd597592365660c864ae6a4243f54c681f469d45dccdfdefe48cb485090775b8fcf7c37ba31b56")**

I took an oath to serve this state because I wanted to do right by the people of Florida. I took that oath knowing that leadership is not cost-free. Knowing that when you step up to lead, you are absolutely going to face opposition. When you stand up, if you're willing to speak the truth, the Left will attack you, they will smear you, they will fight tooth and nail to take you down.

It's not just people like me who are leading a big state who have become the target of the Left's attacks. It's a parent who may go to speak their mind at a school board meeting. | Hi friends!

The final newsletter before tomorrow’s primary. What an incredible journey we’ve been on together this last year-and-a-half. We’ve built an unstoppable grass roots movement of patriots who love this country and want to see it returned to the model of smaller government and greater freedom envisioned by our founders.

I’m incredibly thankful for you all. You’ve blessed us beyond measure with your prayers, time, and donations. If I can mix scripture a bit: We’ve fought the good fight, we’ve finished the race, we’ve kept the faith. We’ve put on the full armor of God, done everything, and now we stand; Stand in faithfulness and expectation for God to move in His people.

Call your family and friends and remind them to vote. Remember, every vote natters! Then continue to pray as we move through the primary, the first milestone in this battle. I would be honored to represent you in Congress.
